## 2026-07-03 Learn Recognition Rebuild Design Checkpoint

用户已确认：执行模式当前相对完整，必须保留；学习模式的整屏理解和定位不符合预期，可以重做前半段识别流程，但要保留后半段学习产物分析展示、Learning Draft Review、DraftGraph Preview、PathGraph candidate 和 promotion validation。当前问题不是单纯 prompt 或模型大小，而是旧学习模式把 `semantic_region_only` 模型框、OCR-only 文本、只读卡片/代码块/标题和硬规则候选直接推入坐标校准层，导致学习 overlay 乱框、错位，并让不可点击内容看起来像可执行目标。

已新增设计规格：`docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-03-learning-recognition-rebuild-design.md`。核心方向是把学习模式前半段改成 `Observe -> Parse UI Inventory -> Classify -> ROI Crop -> Local Ground -> Validate -> learning_template_draft_v1`，再接现有 `load_learning_draft_review -> save_reviewed_template_candidate -> build_pathgraph_candidate_from_review` 后半段。Parser 被定义为可插拔候选来源，只回答“屏幕上有什么”，不能授权点击；Grounding 只处理 `actionable` / `form_field` 候选；Validator 必须检查 OCR/UIA/DOM/OmniParser/vision evidence、coordinate transform replay、screenshot freshness、non-actionable rejection 和 danger-zone/final-submit 阻断。

已新增实施计划：`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-03-learning-recognition-rebuild-plan.md`。计划第一阶段先实现 contracts、parser adapter、non-actionable classifier、ROI/coordinate transform 和 validator，再把输出接回现有 `learning_template_draft_v1`。模型实验限定为 Learn Mode 专用 profile，不覆盖 Execute Mode；候选包括 OmniParser 作为 parser provider、Qwen3-VL 8B 做整屏结构理解、UGround 2B/7B 与 GUI-Actor 3B/7B 做 grounding/verifier、ShowUI 2B 做 trial/对比。任何下载或模型调用都必须记录 `actual_model_call` / `recorded_output_per_config`，不能把 fixture/tool pass 宣传为模型能力。

当前目标仍未完成：还没有实现新 `app.learn.recognition` 代码、benchmark runner 或模型下载实验；也没有证明 90% 以上分层指标。下一步应按计划 Task 1-3 先做最小垂直切片：`screen_inventory_item_v2` 合同、现有 OCR/UIA evidence parser、non-actionable classifier，并用测试证明 OCR-only 普通文本、代码块、只读卡片、semantic-only 中等置信 bbox 不再进入 grounding。

## 2026-07-03 Calibrated Evidence Feeds Learning Draft

本轮先增强坐标校准质量，再把校准结果输入学习草稿二次学习。根因：用户在 python.org demo 中看到 Learn Deep overlay 虽然比上次好，但仍有浏览器工具栏、极小噪声框和父容器/子动作重叠；随后 `运行草稿试跑` 的输出只有 `1` 个 state、`2` 个 region、`2` 个 action，页面详情不足以 demo。旧面板 trial 只把截图发给模型，且使用 `strict_blind`、`max_output_tokens=768`、`learning_image_max_edge=256`、单次尝试，导致模型没有利用刚校准出来的 target / overlay / path-map review 证据。

修复位置分两层：

- 坐标校准层：`learn_all_targets` 在生成最终 overlay 前会过滤 browser chrome / 地址栏 / tab / 顶部浏览器控件和极小噪声框，并继续执行视觉重叠 gate，优先保留输入框、按钮、链接等高价值子动作，移除被子动作覆盖的父容器框。结果里记录 `raw_candidate_count`、`filtered_browser_chrome_count`、`filtered_noise_count`、`visual_overlap_removal_count`，方便判断到底是模型问题、OCR 噪声还是过滤规则生效。
- 学习草稿层：面板 `运行草稿试跑` 改为 demo-oriented 标准模式，默认 `validation_mode=standard`、`max_attempts=2`、`max_output_tokens=3072`、`learning_image_max_edge=768`。前端会构造 `panel_learning_draft_observation_evidence_v1`，把当前 Learn Fast / Learn Deep 的模型角色、截图路径、坐标 overlay、target counts、最多 24 个 calibrated targets、path-map review summary/removals 传给 `app.learn.model_trial` 的 `observation_evidence`。Prompt 也要求模型优先使用这些 calibrated targets 生成 regions/actions，并保留 `source_candidate_id` / `source_target_id` / `bbox` / `click_point` / `section_id` / `source`。

面板审阅也同步增强：Learning Draft 页面详情会显示 evidence source chips，包括 `learning_source`、source path、attempt、semantic model 和 coordinate model；草稿归一化保留 `agent_decision_points`、`operation_skills`、`gate_contracts`、`notes` 等模型产物字段，避免审阅页面把可解释信息丢掉。

边界：这只改善 Learn Mode 的坐标预览质量和 raw draft 生成输入，不授权点击、Execute、safe fill 或 final submit。`standard` 是面板 demo trial 的默认；严格 benchmark 仍可使用 `strict_blind` 和 scorer-only hidden reference，不能把面板 trial 输出宣传为 accuracy 或 E2E 稳定性。

2026-07-03 面板复跑证据：

- Learn Fast trace：`logs\traces\vision\20260703-173955-882461__learn-mode-fast-observe__python-org.json`。
- Learn Deep trace：`logs\traces\vision\20260703-174008-737067__learn-mode-deep-locate__python-org.json`。
- 坐标 overlay：`artifacts\review-overlays\state-b8bed884c84100e8-learn-targets__learn-target-coordinates__20260703-174008-660067.png`，`raw_candidate_count=40`、`filtered_browser_chrome_count=3`、`target_count=35`、`validated_count=35`。
- 校准后学习草稿 trial：`artifacts\learning-runs\panel_20260703-174150-782_python.org\trial_result.json`，`states=1`、`regions=12`、`action_templates=12`，仍是 `raw_learning_trial` / `draft_only`。
- 面板截图：`artifacts\screenshots\openclaw-console-1-microsoft-edge__capture__full-window__20260703-174540-891461.png` 显示草稿摘要/状态/区域/动作/安全状态；`artifacts\screenshots\openclaw-console-1-microsoft-edge__capture__full-window__20260703-174559-475587.png` 显示草稿路径图预览和页面详情。

## 2026-07-03 Learn Deep Visual Target Overlap Gate

修复：Learn Deep / `learn_all_targets` 的最终坐标校准 overlay 不再允许明显重叠的可校准 target 同时通过。根因是 `_apply_learn_locate_model_review_to_screen_map()` 只有在模型 review `status=ready` 时才运行 deterministic overlap hard rule；当模型 review skipped 时，screen_map candidates 会原样进入 Learn All Targets。另外旧的 path candidate overlap rule 明确允许 parent-child containment，导致 `ocr_card_groups` 大卡片和内部 OCR/link/action 小框会一起出现在最终选区 overlay。

现在分两层处理：结构层的 `_prune_non_containment_overlaps()` 仍保留 parent-child 关系，但即使模型 review skipped 也会运行非包含式 overlap 移除；最终 Learn All Targets 增加 `learn_target_visual_overlap_rule`，在坐标校准/overlay 层移除被更高优先级子动作覆盖的父容器框，并记录 `visual_overlap_removals` / `visual_overlap_removal_count`。用 python.org 真实 trace `20260703-161247-235050__learn-mode-deep-locate__welcome-to-python-org.json` 重放验证：旧 target_count=43 且有 21 对明显冲突，新规则 target_count=33，重叠冲突对为 0。该修复只收紧学习坐标预览和候选质量，不授权点击、Execute、safe fill 或 final submit。

## 2026-07-03 Learning Studio Current-Window Draft Trial

Learning Studio 现在可以用当前绑定窗口生成学习草稿预览。`截取当前绑定窗口` 只调用 read-only `POST /vision/observe_screen`，使用 `write_policy.path_graph=false`，保存截图路径和 observe trace，不执行点击、输入或写入正式 PathGraph。`运行草稿试跑` 调用新增的 `POST /panel/run_learning_model_trial`，用当前截图运行 `app.learn.model_trial.build_learning_model_trial()`，把 raw result 保存到 `artifacts\learning-runs\panel_...\trial_result.json`，并把路径填入 `learningTrialResultPath` 和 `learningDraftReviewSourcePath` 后自动加载 Learning Draft Review。

这个预览明确标记为 `raw_learning_trial` / `draft_only` / `draft_graph_preview`，并强制 `runtime_path_graph=false`、`artifact_is_authorization=false`、`execute_binding_enabled=false`、`real_clicks=0`、`live_safe_fill_attempted=0`、`promotion_allowed=false`、`final_submit_forbidden=true`。它不会默认填写 Template Replay 的 `replayModelArtifactPath`，不会派生 replay artifact，不授权 Execute，也不代表模型能力或 E2E 稳定性。任意新网站没有 hidden reference 时，面板 API 返回 `reference_available=false`、`alignment_score=not_available`，不把 raw draft trial 结果包装成 accuracy 或成功率。

Learning Studio 也新增了简单的人工候选生成工具。`生成候选 PathGraph` 会复用当前 Learning Draft Review 中的 blockers / verification rules / review status，调用 `POST /panel/generate_pathgraph_candidate`，保存 `reviewed_template_candidate.json` 后生成 `pathgraph_candidate.json`、`runtime_path_graph_candidate.json`、`interface_map_candidate.json` 和 `promotion_validation_report.json`。validator 覆盖 schema count、action-region linkage、blockers、verification rules、submit/send/complete/confirm/final apply 风险词、authorization flags 和 `operation_dispatch=not_executed`。即使返回 `validation_status=passed_candidate`，它仍然是 non-executable candidate，不会填入 Template Replay 的 `replayGraphPath`，不会调用 Execute，也不授权点击、输入、safe fill 或 final submit。

## 2026-07-03 Learn Replay Template / Draft Subinterfaces

Learn Replay 的面板现在有两个明确子界面：`模板界面` 专门用于 Template Replay / Runtime PathGraph / Interface Map / validation/task-run harness；`学习草稿界面` 专门用于 Learning Studio / raw trial / DraftGraph Preview / reviewed candidate / PathGraph candidate。`加载模型产物` 只加载派生出来的 Runtime PathGraph / Interface Map 回放资产，并在响应里标记 `learning_draft_review_auto_loaded=false`；它会预填学习草稿来源路径，并把审阅状态重置为 `not_loaded · source path prepared; click Load learning draft`，但不会自动把模型学习草稿渲染到审阅面板。学习草稿必须在 `学习草稿界面` 里通过 `加载学习草稿` 或 `运行草稿试跑` 单独进入 Learning Studio，仍然是 display-only / reviewed-candidate 流程，不授权点击、Execute 绑定、live safe fill 或最终提交。

修复：打开模板并加载 Runtime PathGraph 后，切换到 `学习草稿界面` 不再继续显示模板界面的共享导航路径图和页面详情。根因是子界面切换只更新了内部 tab/panel active 状态，没有同步外层 `navPathPanel` / `pathDetailPanel` 这两个共享回放面板。现在 `setLearnReplaySubview()` 会记录当前子界面，并在 Learn Replay stage 下给 body 添加模板/草稿视图状态类；草稿视图隐藏共享 PathGraph/Page Detail，切回模板视图或离开 Learn Replay 时恢复。该修复只影响前端展示隔离，不改变 Execute、Gate、final submit guard、safe fill 或 PathGraph 运行时授权。

进一步收敛 demo 界面：`模板界面` 默认只保留加载产物、加载界面地图、加载校准报告、带入安全验证、带入任务运行这条主路径；模型产物、Profile、Prompt 版本管理、保存地图、生成验证计划和执行下一步等开发/调试按钮收进 `高级操作` 折叠区。`学习草稿界面` 加入草稿摘要和 section counts，并且 loader 兼容 `reviewed_template_candidate_v1` / 顶层 `draft.states/regions/action_templates`，避免已保存候选或顶层草稿显示为空。SEEK 默认 interface map 中 `seek:visual:search_button` 的 stale 截图证据已修正为现存全屏 source screenshot 和真正的粉色 SEEK 搜索按钮 crop；这只修展示和学习证据，不授权点击。

修复：Interface Map 同一区域里的 fixed visual assets 现在按屏幕 bbox 位置排序，而不是沿用 JSON 数组顺序。这样 SEEK 顶部搜索区会按真实视觉顺序显示 `Search input field` 在左、`Search button` 在右；该变更只影响面板展示顺序，不改变资产内容、Gate 或执行授权。

修复：学习草稿加载不再只依赖 `learningDraftReviewSourcePath` 单个输入框。前端会依次从学习草稿来源、最新 trial 结果、候选 PathGraph、候选校验报告和模型 trial 路径推断可加载来源；生成候选 PathGraph 后也会自动把 `reviewed_template_candidate_path` 回填为草稿审阅来源。后端 `load_learning_draft_review()` 现在也能接收 `pathgraph_candidate_v1` wrapper 或 `pathgraph_candidate_validation_report_v1`，并反查对应的 reviewed template candidate。该修复只影响 display/review-only 加载链路，不授权 Execute、点击、safe fill 或 final submit。

已保存一套可直接加载的 python.org 网站学习草稿 demo：raw trial 为 `artifacts/learning-runs/new_site_python_org_20260702_after_similarity_fix/trial_result.json`，reviewed candidate 为 `artifacts/learning-draft-review/trial_result_cae1c88703/reviewed_template_candidate.json`，候选 PathGraph 为 `artifacts/learning-draft-review/trial_result_cae1c88703/pathgraph_candidate/pathgraph_candidate.json`，校验报告为 `artifacts/learning-draft-review/trial_result_cae1c88703/pathgraph_candidate/promotion_validation_report.json`。这些路径现在作为学习草稿界面的默认 demo 值，刷新面板后可以直接点 `加载学习草稿`。当前 demo draft 可加载出 `states=1`、`regions=3`、`action_templates=3`，仍然是 display/review-only，不授权 Execute 或真实操作。

学习草稿界面现在有独立的只读 `草稿路径图预览` 和 `页面详情` 区。它直接从 `learning_template_draft_v1` / reviewed candidate 的 `states`、`regions`、`action_templates`、`blockers`、`verification_rules` 渲染 DraftGraph Preview，不复用 Template Replay 的共享 `navPathCanvas` / Page Detail，也不会调用 `renderRuntimePathGraph`、Execute、Gate、safe fill 或 click 授权。这个预览只用于面试/demo 和人工审阅，让学习草稿看起来接近模板，但仍然保持 `candidate / not executable`。

## 2026-07-02 Final Demo Readiness Package

Checkpoint 7 prepares the stage-close package without adding runtime features or rerunning live automation. The package is `FINAL_DEMO_READINESS_PACKAGE.md`, with links from `README.md`, `PROJECT_SUMMARY.md`, and `NEXT_STEPS.md`.

Current evidence:

- SEEK scaffold manifest: `artifacts\benchmarks\seek_mvp_golden_manifest_v1.json`, 40 cases.
- latest SEEK scaffold benchmark: `logs\benchmarks\seek_mvp_final_scaffold\seek_mvp_benchmark_report.json`.
- latest model-learning final validation: `logs\benchmarks\model_learning_feedback_loop_final\feedback_report.json`.
- latest controlled live no-submit smoke: `logs\smoke\seek_live_no_submit_checkpoint6\checkpoint6_live_smoke_summary.json`.

The final package conclusion is intentionally narrow: the project is a benchmark-driven Windows GUI Agent Runtime with a SEEK no-submit MVP scaffold. It supports traceable action planning, safety gating, benchmarked point-grounding evidence, final-submit guard fixtures, safe-fill policy fixtures, model-learning template validation, and a display-only Learning Draft Review workspace. It does not claim live safe-fill reliability, live submission, stable SEEK end-to-end automation, or model accuracy from template similarity.

Current explicit limitations:

- live `safe_fill` remains `attempted=0 / rate=not_covered`.
- CP6 live smoke did not cover job detail opening, Apply entry, external ATS, login blocker, final submit visible blocker, or live safe fill.
- `seek_point_grounding_missed_failure` remains `invalid_point_grounding_fixture / evidence_missing` and is excluded from attempted denominators.
- model-learning selected config remains baseline; no prompt/config trial is accepted for model ability.
- fixture pass does not equal live pass, and safe stop does not equal completed E2E flow.

## 2026-07-02 Model-Learning Template Feedback Loop

This round adds a fixed-fixture benchmark and bounded negative-feedback loop for raw model-generated `learning_template_draft_v1` outputs.

Checkpoint 4.10/4.11 adds a minimal Learning Draft Review workspace to the Learn Replay panel. It is display/review-only: `/panel/load_learning_draft_review` loads the raw draft from a model trial into a template-like view, and `/panel/save_learning_draft_review` saves a reviewer-edited candidate while forcing `source_after_review=mixed` or `assisted_generation`, `counts_as_pure_model_generated=false`, `artifact_is_authorization=false`, `execute_binding_enabled=false`, `authorization_scope=display_and_review_only`, and `final_submit_forbidden=true`. This gives the user a simple place to inspect and refine a draft for demo/interview purposes without editing JSON/Markdown, but it does not count as pure model ability evidence and does not authorize Execute, live safe fill, or submit.

Changes:

- Added `scripts\run_model_learning_template_benchmark.py`.
- Added `scripts\run_model_learning_feedback_loop.py`.
- Added `artifacts\benchmarks\model_learning_template_dev_manifest_v1.json`, `artifacts\benchmarks\model_learning_template_holdout_manifest_v1.json`, and fixture templates under `artifacts\benchmarks\model_learning_templates\`.

Each export stores prompt input, raw model output, parsed generated template, hidden reference, model config, source trace path, and screenshot checksum.
- Added `tests\test_model_learning_template_feedback_loop.py`.
- The baseline benchmark reports `attempted`, `usable_template_candidate`, `needs_human_review`, `invalid_or_unsafe_template`, `draft_reference_alignment_score`, `hard_requirement_passed`, `missing_required_fields`, `extra_unsafe_actions`, `loader_compatibility`, `agent_usable`, `failure_reason`, `generated_template_path`, and `reference_template_path`.
- The benchmark validates hard required fields, submit/send/complete/final-apply safety, loader compatibility through `app.learn.model_artifact_loader`, and deterministic agent usability through region/action/verification linking checks.
- Invalid fixture evidence such as screenshot checksum mismatch is excluded from attempted model denominators and does not trigger model tuning.
- The feedback runner changes one parameter or strategy per trial on dev, records both per-trial delta and baseline delta, then reruns the selected config on dev and holdout. Holdout is explicitly `holdout_used_for_tuning=false`.
- Reports include source breakdown, reference-leakage audit, prompt-profile safety inheritance audit, baseline-vs-selected delta tables, per-case model-generated diagnosis, and `model_generated_failure_taxonomy`. Source tracking distinguishes `actual_model_call`, `recorded_model_output`, `recorded_output_per_config`, `assisted_generation`, `human_curated`, `mixed`, and `fixture_only`.

The report includes `learning_template_required_contract_v1`, accepted schema paths, found schema paths, and a non-executed `missing_sections_patch` retry plan for missing logical fields. ## 2026-07-02 Reviewer-Style SEEK Benchmark And Score Naming

This round moved the current reviewer requirements into code, tests, and a fixed benchmark scaffold instead of continuing prompt tuning.

Changes:

- Learning draft scores are now reported as `draft_reference_alignment_score` with alias `template_similarity_score`. They must not be described as model accuracy, click success rate, gate success rate, or SEEK end-to-end success.
- The current learning draft pipeline is only initially runnable on small search-input/template-draft subtasks. It does not yet prove general website learning capability, and it does not prove SEEK E2E stability.
- `app.learn.model_trial` records `human_adjudication` for contested low-score cases. A suspected scorer false negative must include an explicit scope such as `search_input_subtask_only`.
- `scripts\seek_speed_demo_runner.py` now safe-stops when `external_ats + login_required` is detected. The runner emits `status=safe_stop`, `stop_reason=external_ats_login_required_safe_stop`, records `state_machine_failure.category=surface_drift_prevented`, and does not continue SEEK result extraction, result scrolling, or next-card lookup.
- Result scrolling is split into `scroll_dispatch_success` and `scroll_effect_success`; only effect success is a real scroll success signal.
- `tests\test_final_submit_guard_fixtures.py` covers final submit wording fixtures: `Submit application`, `Send application`, `Complete`, `Apply now`, `Confirm`, `Review and submit`, `Submit`, disabled submit, sticky footer submit, and modal submit. Each expects `unsafe_prevented=true`, `real_clicks=0`, and `submit_clicks=0`. `Apply now` is not globally blocked; it is blocked only when it appears inside an active application/final-review form or modal scope.
- `Review and submit` is also context-sensitive: SEEK progress-step labels remain non-final, while explicit final-review submit context or `final_submit` action metadata is blocked.
- `artifacts\benchmarks\seek_mvp_golden_manifest_v1.json` provides 22 high-value cases across normal results, detail read terminal states, scroll outcomes, external ATS, login blocker, Easy Apply form inventory, final review submit blocker, wrong surface, no Apply, popup/modal, and one exposed point-grounding failure.
- `scripts\run_seek_mvp_benchmark.py` reruns the manifest and outputs layered metrics only: `model_draft_alignment`, `candidate_recall`, `point_grounding`, `click_open_detail`, `read_completeness`, `scroll_dispatch`, `scroll_effect`, `apply_entry`, `external_blocker_detection`, `form_inventory`, `safe_fill`, `safe_fill_fixture`, `final_submit_guard`, and `full_no_submit_e2e`. Each metric has `passed / attempted / rate`; if `attempted=0`, `rate=not_covered`. Failures include `case_id`, `failure_category`, `trace_path`, `screenshot_path`, `expected`, and `actual`.

2026-07-02 follow-up benchmark use:

- `artifacts\benchmarks\seek_mvp_golden_manifest_v1.json` was expanded from 11 to 22 cases, still intentionally below the later 50-case target.
- The runner now emits top-level `failure_diagnosis`, with root cause and proposed fix for every failed metric.
- `read_completeness` is no longer a loose boolean. It classifies `still_reading`, `reached_bottom`, `max_captures`, `no_new_content`, `wrong_surface`, and `blocked_surface`, so `max_captures` cannot be counted as read complete.
- `scroll_effect` is no longer dispatch success. It classifies target-container content change, reached bottom, dispatch failure, no fingerprint change, wrong container/no scroll, wrong surface, and blocked surface.
- `full_no_submit_e2e` validates the no-submit state chain: SEEK results -> job detail -> Apply entry -> external ATS -> login_required -> safe_stop, with no continued card loop, no safe fill, and no submit.
- Latest offline report: `logs\benchmarks\seek_mvp_final_scaffold\seek_mvp_benchmark_report.json` has `sample_count=40`; the old `read_completeness`, `scroll_effect`, and `full_no_submit_e2e` failures are fixed as classifier/state-machine cases. The previous `seek_point_grounding_missed_failure` remains an invalid fixture because it lacks auditable point-grounding evidence. The valid point-grounding set includes two confirmed-point SEEK traces, one recognition-plan/VISTA success fixture, and one recognition-plan/VISTA point miss that Gate rejected before click. The new `safe_fill_fixture` cases cover allowed identity/contact/profile URL fields, cover letter textarea, sensitive/review fields, unsupported file upload, final-submit visible blocking, wrong surface, and modal blocking.

2026-07-02 reviewer checkpoint hardening:

- `scripts\run_seek_mvp_benchmark.py` now treats screenshot checksum mismatch as case-level `invalid / stale_fixture`. Stale fixtures do not enter metric attempted/pass/fail denominators, and the report includes `expected_checksum`, `actual_checksum`, `case_id`, and `screenshot_path`.
- `seek_point_grounding_missed_failure` is `invalid_point_grounding_fixture / evidence_missing`, not `point_grounding_miss`: the referenced trace is an execute-step input dry-run, so it has no actual grounding point, candidate bbox, coordinate transform, gate result, or overlay. The runner places this case in `invalid_cases` / `fixture_validity_failures` and excludes it from the `point_grounding_success` attempted denominator. The new report has `point_grounding_success={passed:3, attempted:4, rate:0.75, coverage_status:minimum_categories_covered, reliability_status:insufficient_sample_size}` and `covered_categories=[confirmed_point_success, gate_rejected_click, point_grounding_miss, point_grounding_success, vista_recognition_plan_point]`. The gate-rejected miss is reported as `point_quality=failed_outside_expected_bbox`, `gate_safety=passed_rejected`, and `case_outcome=safe_intercept`; the independent `gate_rejected_click` safety metric is `passed=1 / attempted=1`. This is only layered benchmark evidence; it is not a SEEK E2E stability claim.
- `safe_fill_fixture` is now fixture-covered, not live-covered. The report records `safe_fill_fixture={passed:21, attempted:21, rate:1.0, coverage_status:minimum_fixture_categories_covered, interpretation:fixture-only; no live form filling}`, while live `safe_fill` remains `attempted=0 / rate=not_covered`. Allowed fixture fields are first name, last name, preferred name, email, phone/mobile, city/suburb, LinkedIn URL, GitHub URL, portfolio/website, and cover letter textarea. Blocked fixture fields include salary expectation, complex visa status, relocation, ethnicity, gender, disability/health, criminal history, final submit, wrong surface, and modal overlay. Unsupported fixture field is resume file upload. The report records clear-existing fields, redaction evidence, and no-submit evidence without live filling.
- Grep audit output is saved at `logs\benchmarks\seek_mvp_next2\legacy_grep_audit.txt`. Remaining `accuracy`/`success rate` hits are generated artifacts, legacy compatibility fields, historical `seek_mvp_accuracy_summary_v1`, or explicit forbidden-interpretation text. The stale Learning Pattern doc was corrected to use `draft_reference_alignment_score` / `template_similarity_score` instead of direct-use accuracy claims.

## 2026-07-01 Model Artifact Loader For Direct-Use Learning Products

This round fixed the missing bridge between raw model learning output and the panel/runtime replay path.

Failure: the new learning trial could produce a raw `learning_template_draft_v1`, but the Learn Replay panel could only load existing PathGraph / Interface Map assets. The model product was not visible as a separate artifact, and using it in Execute would have required either hand-editing the learned product or falling back to old templates.

Root invariant violated: model learning output must remain immutable and directly auditable, while the runtime may use a separate loader-derived artifact to adapt the model contract into current `runtime_path_graph_v1` / `learned_interface_map_v1` shapes.

Fix location: common learning loader plus panel API/UI.

- Added `app\learn\model_artifact_loader.py`.
- Added `POST /panel/load_model_artifact`.
- Added Learn Replay controls for `replayModelArtifactPath` and `replayModelArtifactLoadBtn`.
- The loader records source path, source SHA-256, attempt index, `readonly=true`, and `posthoc_optimization_allowed=false`.
- The loader writes derived files under `artifacts\model-artifact-loader\...\runtime_path_graph.json` and `interface_map.json`.
- If a model draft has action templates but no transitions, the loader creates guidance-only same-state transitions so `/execute/available_actions` can enumerate them.
- Source model artifacts are not modified, not promoted to Profile/PathGraph, and not treated as click authorization.
- Learn Replay now selects `model_artifact_single_step` after loading a model artifact. That task template uses the loaded graph path, uses the loaded first state, passes `dry_run=true`, and keeps `dispatch_low_level=false`.
- Model-loaded runtime graphs skip app-preset Interface Map inference. This prevents a SEEK-labeled model graph from replacing the loader-derived `interface_map.json` with the old default SEEK template map.
- `/execute/*` runtime graph paths now resolve relative to the project root and are constrained to `artifacts` / `logs`, so panel-returned relative artifact paths work consistently outside the default cwd assumption.
- Runtime graph safety now includes `final_submit_forbidden=true`, and the panel summary reads either `safety_policy` or loader `safety`.

Why not app-only: this is the reusable contract for any future website/software model product. SEEK is only the current smoke artifact; the loader accepts any `learning_model_trial_v1` with a usable `best_learning_draft`.

Safety impact: no safety was loosened. Derived graphs set `artifact_is_authorization=false`, input policies keep `submit_allowed=false`, and Execute still treats actions as guidance-only with Gate/current-validation requirements.

Real smoke:

- Source: `artifacts\learning-runs\strict_blind_8b_template_similarity_after_canonical_20260701-222931\trial_result.json`.
- Loader output: `artifacts\model-artifact-loader\strict_blind_8b_template_similarity_after_canonical_20260701-222931_trial_result_4cdd7d51c2\runtime_path_graph.json` and `interface_map.json`.
- `/execute/available_actions` returned one model-learned action: `a1`, `low_level_action_type=input`, taxonomy `fill_field`, input target `r1`.
- `/execute/step` dry-run planned that action with `path_graph_assisted=true`, `low_level_action_type=input`, `dispatch_low_level=false`, and `final_submit=false`.
- Browser panel smoke on local `uvicorn` port `8765` with headless Microsoft Edge loaded the same trial through the visible Learn Replay button. The panel wrote back the loader-derived graph path and loader-derived interface-map path, selected `model_artifact_single_step`, set `replayStateId=s1`, and displayed `FINAL_SUBMIT_FORBIDDEN=true` / `ARTIFACT_IS_AUTHORIZATION=false`.
- The same browser smoke clicked `Execute next step`; the panel task run completed one step with `planned_not_executed`, `input=1`, `passed=1`, and `final_submissions=0`.

Verification:

- `uv run pytest tests\test_web_panel_route.py::test_web_panel_serves_browser_control_surface tests\test_web_panel_route.py::test_web_panel_serves_static_assets -q` passed, `2 passed`.

## 2026-07-01 Generic Learning Trial Rebuild Slice

Added a replacement trial path that does not use the old SEEK draft/tune workflow:

- `app\learn\model_trial.py`
- `GET /runtime/learning/model_trial`
- Observe task `learn_template_draft`
- raw output contract `learning_template_draft_v1`
- scorer contract `learning_template_draft_score_v1`

The trial requires an explicit `image_path`, calls the Observe model, scores only the raw model output, and feeds missing contract sections / safety failures / action semantic gaps into the next attempt's parameters. It supports `max_output_tokens`, `temperature`, and `timeout_seconds`; model exceptions become scored `model_error` attempts instead of crashing the whole trial.

Real model evidence and validation correction:

- Qwen3VL-8B was running on `http://127.0.0.1:1240/v1`.
- Qwen3VL-4B was started on `http://127.0.0.1:1241/v1`.
- `artifacts\learning-runs\generic_model_trial_20260701-192244\trial_result.json` shows the compressed prompt / 256px learning image budget can let Qwen3VL-8B return a raw `learning_template_draft_v1` in one attempt. The old `best_score_percent=100.0` is now downgraded to weak smoke evidence because the scorer did not require explicit validation actions.
- `artifacts\learning-runs\generic_model_trial_feedback_20260701-192334\trial_result.json` proves the feedback path: attempt 0 used Qwen3VL-8B with `timeout_seconds=1`, failed as structured `model_error`, scored 21%, and emitted feedback for `prompt_detail_mode`, `max_output_tokens`, `learning_model_profile_id`, `learning_image_max_edge`, and `timeout_seconds`; attempt 1 automatically switched to Qwen3VL-4B with `timeout_seconds=90` and returned raw `learning_template_draft_v1`. The old 100% score is not accepted as direct-use proof because the prompt contained `app=seek` / `state=search input crop` and the scorer allowed no validation answer.
- `app.learn.model_trial` now defaults to `validation_mode=strict_blind`: app name, state hint, goal, observation evidence, expected actions, and expected visible text are hidden from the model prompt; the scorer keeps those as private validation criteria and hard-fails when strict validation has no expected action answer.
- Follow-up correction: no-draft attempts now record `result_kind=model_error_no_draft`, `quality_score_applicable=false`, and `quality_score_percent=null`. Their diagnostic score must not be compared with scored model output. Timeout/no-draft feedback keeps the same quality model by default and adjusts runtime parameters first; Qwen3VL-4B fallback requires `allow_fast_profile_fallback=true`.
- Quality optimization is now staged correctly: prompt detail / output-token / schema-tuning feedback starts only after at least one scored draft exists. The quality optimization ladder is based on scored-draft count, not raw attempt count, so a timeout does not skip the first quality-improvement prompt.
- The generic learning prompt now requires every visible interactive region to produce an action template. Search/input/text fields must produce `semantic_action="type_text"`, and visible buttons/cards/links must produce open-detail/open-flow style actions when appropriate.
- Scoring no longer overfits private expected action labels by default. `expected_actions[].semantic_action` is the primary match; label matching is enforced only when `require_label_match=true`.
- Scoring now supports template-similarity mode through private `target_contract.reference_template`. When present, quality score is dominated by similarity to the reference template: workflow states, action templates, interface regions, and safety are compared as structured objects. Safety remains a hard gate, so similarity cannot authorize final submit, promotion, or real clicks.
- `strict_blind` keeps the reference template scorer-only. The model prompt receives the required output shape, but not `reference_template`, expected actions, app/state hints, or old learning evidence.
- Template-similarity scoring now canonicalizes equivalent state/region semantics before scoring. Blind ids such as `s1` / `r1` have low weight; `job_search_initial` / `search_page` can match a job-search state; `search_input_field` with role `text_input` can match `search_field` only when search/query evidence is present. Counter-regression keeps ordinary email/name text inputs from normalizing into search fields.

## 2026-07-01 real SEEK learned-artifact execution validation

Used the current learned SEEK artifacts against a live SEEK page instead of only comparing them to templates. The first live dry-run reproduced a reusable runtime bug: the same job title appeared as overlapping UIA text/link candidates with identical scores, so `pre_click_decision_v1` rejected the correct target because `margin_to_second=0.0`. The common decision layer now treats only different-element, same-text, overlapping candidates as equivalent duplicates; it keeps non-equivalent nearby text such as `at` rejected by the low-margin rule.

The same live session then generated a SEEK Observe trace with learned PathGraph/interface-map assets and passed it into Execute. That exposed two parameter/contract gaps: visual asset fast-lane could match a SEEK brand/top-search asset because the goal mentioned `SEEK`, and pre-click could treat context words such as `SEEK` or `at` as positive targets when the real action was `Apply`. Visual asset relevance now requires the asset to match the explicit action term when a goal contains Apply/Save/Search/Filter/Continue/Submit intent; generic brand/context tokens do not qualify. Pre-click now records `candidate_goal_action_mismatch` for candidates that do not match the explicit action target. Apply entry policy was also aligned with the runtime contract: `safe_click_allowed + Apply` is allowed as an `open_apply_flow` entry, while `Submit application` remains blocked.

Live evidence:

- Real gated click opened the first SEEK job detail only: `logs\traces\actions\20260701-151755-550560__execute-mode-click__edge.json`, verified by post-click screenshot diff, with `final_submissions=0`.
- Learned-artifact Observe trace: `logs\traces\vision\20260701-151905-435293__learn-mode-fast-observe__seek.json`, `learned_path_graph_used=true`.
- Final Apply dry-run using that trace: `logs\traces\actions\20260701-152527-318592__execute-mode-plan-preview__seek.json`; `path_graph_recall.status=ready`, selected candidate is the learned Apply visual asset at `{x: 816, y: 1020}`, `allowed_candidate_count=1`, and SEEK/at context candidates are rejected.

## 2026-07-01 Learning Mode direct-use validation gate

Learning Mode scoring now treats template coverage as only the first gate. `learning_eval_report_v1.coverage` can still report `learning_template_coverage_report_v1` and a 100% hidden-template match, but that no longer means learning success. `learning_eval_report_v1.site_validation` now reports `learning_site_validation_report_v1`, and `learning_eval_report_v1.overall_learning_score` stays failed with `reason=site_validation_not_run` unless the raw learned draft is validated against a real or recorded website snapshot.

The new pass criterion is direct Agent usability: with a `site_snapshot_path`, direct-use validation must score at least `0.9` and have no hard safety errors. The evaluated artifact must remain the raw learning output; failures feed back into prompt/model parameters and scoring standards, not post-hoc edits to the learned product.

Follow-up scoring upgrade: `site_snapshot.validation_cases[]` can now describe action-level direct-use checks. The SEEK validation snapshot `artifacts\learning-runs\seek_direct_use_site_snapshot_v1.json` covers five Agent-facing cases: open a job detail, Save/bookmark, Apply entry, Quick Apply entry, and final Submit application blocking. A second recorded-real-screenshot snapshot, `artifacts\learning-runs\seek_recorded_search_snapshot_qwen8b_20260616.json`, is derived from `artifacts\accuracy-checks\understanding_model_benchmark_qwen8b.json` and covers dynamic SEEK job cards plus Save search. The current generic model-trial learning parameters are fixed at `learning_model_profile_id=qwen3_vl_8b_q4_k_m`, `temperature=0.0`, `max_output_tokens=768`, `timeout_seconds=180`, `learning_image_max_edge=256`, `direct_use_accuracy_threshold=0.9`, `artifact_posthoc_optimization_allowed=false`, and `allow_fast_profile_fallback=false`.

Follow-up tuning loop history: the old SEEK-specific tune route has been removed from the promoted learning surface. The replacement model-trial route applies `learning_model_profile_id`, `metadata.temperature`, `max_output_tokens`, `timeout_seconds`, and `learning_image_max_edge` to the actual Observe model request, scores the raw returned `learning_template_draft_v1`, and applies feedback only to the next attempt's parameters. It does not patch the scored artifact and does not promote profile or PathGraph changes.

## 2026-07-01 Learning Mode panel review/loading UI

Learn Replay now separates template inspection from learning-draft inspection with a two-button view switch. The template view shows the current input/source assets. The learning-draft view shows the generated SEEK template draft, navigation PathGraph draft, interface details, pattern candidates, draft map, eval, and safety review. It includes a local review marker plus buttons to load the draft navigation graph into the existing Navigation Path renderer and load the draft interface details into the existing Interface Map renderer. These buttons are preview/review only: they do not write Profile, PathGraph, interface map artifacts, or action authorization.

Follow-up fix: generating a learning draft now auto-loads the draft navigation graph into the shared Navigation Path canvas and auto-loads the draft interface details into the Interface Map preview. The explicit buttons remain available for review/reload, but the main graph no longer stays on `live / idle` after a successful draft generation.

Coverage-loop update: `learning_eval_report_v1` now includes `learning_template_coverage_report_v1`. It treats the SEEK template/profile/PathGraph/interface-map assets as a hidden benchmark, requires `coverage_ratio >= 0.9`, records missing items and semantic mismatches as reviewable lists, keeps hard safety errors separate, and emits prompt/parameter feedback when coverage drops below threshold or safety taxonomy fails.

### 2026-06-29 Agentic Loop-first architecture reset

本轮按用户最新架构判断，把项目主叙事从 SEEK workflow-first 调整为通用 GUI Agent Runtime。

核心结论：

- 执行模式默认是 Agentic Loop-first：`observe -> Agent decision -> Gate -> Operation -> Trace -> observe`。
- Workflow / PathGraph 不是执行入口硬前提，而是学习出来的可复用资产；有就由 Agent 选择使用，没有就继续动态探索。
- Human Review / Approval 不是独立层，而是 Agent decision 的 `ask_user_required` 输出。
- 学习模式的目标是把人工演示、Agent 探索和历史 Trace 学成更具体的 PathGraph。
- SEEK 不再作为主架构中心，而是 app/software profile。

落地：

- 新增 `docs\GUI_AGENT_RUNTIME_ARCHITECTURE.zh-CN.md`，记录五层职责、两种执行形态、PathGraph 定位、profile 位置和迁移顺序。
- 新增 `app\runtime_architecture\contracts.py`，提供 `gui_agent_runtime_architecture_v1`、`app_profile_v1`、`operation_request_v1`、`gate_decision_v1`、`trace_event_v1` 的第一阶段合同。
- 新增实际层入口 `app\operation`、`app\gate`、`app\trace`：Operation 暴露 framework skill catalog 和 profile skill mapping；Gate 暴露 candidate freshness、target-at-point validation、action taxonomy、danger、scroll scope、latest-detail dataflow 和 OCR normalization；Trace 暴露 `trace_event_v1` 记录入口。
- 核心 Gate / Operation 合同已从 facade 推进到实现体迁移：`app.gate.actions`、`app.gate.candidates`、`app.gate.danger`、`app.gate.scroll`、`app.gate.dataflow`、`app.gate.ocr`、`app.gate.window` 现在拥有实现；`app.operation.path_graph`、`app.operation.step`、`app.operation.visual_asset_matching`、`app.operation.reading`、`app.operation.verification` 现在拥有实现。旧 `app.execute.*` 兼容包已删除，新调用必须直接使用新层。

  - Why not SEEK-only：这是动作分类前置问题。任何已学习网站都应先用当前 detail snapshot 的低成本证据排除不适用入口，再调用昂贵定位模型。
  - Regression：`tests/test_seek_debug_step_runner.py::test_read_detail_batch_updates_state_detail_for_match` 覆盖 OCR `Apply` 写入 detail snapshot；`tests/test_seek_debug_step_runner.py::test_execute_apply_entry_skipped_does_not_wait_for_application_flow` 覆盖 skipped 不等待申请流；`tests/test_seek_mvp_traversal_runner.py::test_execute_apply_entry_blocks_standard_apply_before_click` 覆盖标准 Apply 不发滚动/定位请求。
  - Safety impact：没有放宽安全策略；只减少站外入口的误进入。`Quick apply`、Continue、final submit 仍走关键验证。
- `uv run pytest tests\test_seek_debug_step_runner.py tests\test_seek_mvp_traversal_runner.py tests\test_seek_speed_demo_runner.py -q` 通过 `111 passed`。
- 新一轮按“只在关键位置强 Gate”继续收口雇主问题页：

### 2026-06-25 Learn replay node detail and key-gate simplification

本轮按用户反馈先暂停真实 SEEK 全流程，回到学习产物面板做根因修复和窄验证。

问题根因：

- `showNavNodeDetail()` 的页面详情、`Screen regions`、右侧 inspector 不是稳定读取同一份节点绑定区域。`pathDetailInterfaceInspectorHtml()` 之前会把全局所有 region 交给 inspector，而不是当前节点的 `region_refs / required_regions`。

- `interfaceRegionRefsForState()` 同时支持 `region_refs` 和 `required_regions`，兼容旧 runtime state 与新的 display state。
- 页面节点详情重新显示 runtime graph 的可调用 workflow / skill；点击具体 region 后，右侧 inspector 仍显示该 region 的 workflow、按钮截图、动态 ROI 和字段详情。
- SEEK 申请页 runtime graph 补齐 `application_review_step`，并把 `application_review` 挂到该 step 下。

### 2026-06-25 SEEK region-read speed and search input asset fix

本轮按 demo 暴露的三个问题收口，先修学习产物和 runtime 读详情主路径，没有继续完整真实跑 SEEK：

1. 搜索框截图资产错误：

   - Fix location：默认 SEEK interface map。新增 `seek:visual:search_input`，角色为 `input`，语义为 `type_public_search_query`，截图来自真实 SEEK 搜索输入框。
   - Regression：`test_seek_default_interface_map_contains_home_page_visual_assets` 现在断言 `search_input` crop 存在、角色为 input，且不能混用 `search_button` crop。

2. 点击卡片后阅读间隔过长：
   - Failure：speed demo 在打开卡片后仍先跑完整 `verify_detail`，再批量阅读详情，浪费一次整屏理解/定位。
   - Root invariant：已经有页面 region 时，长文本阅读应优先使用 learned `seek:job_detail` 区域截图/OCR，不应每次先走整屏详情验证。
   - Fix location：`scripts/seek_debug_step_runner.py` 与 `scripts/seek_speed_demo_runner.py`。`read_detail_batch` 现在可从 `current_job` + learned `seek:job_detail` bbox 直接开始区域 OCR；speed demo 的卡片点击后流程改为 `execute_card -> read_detail_batch -> match`。
   - Regression：`test_read_detail_batch_can_start_from_learned_region_without_verify` 和 `test_speed_demo_reads_detail_batch_without_full_verify_after_card_click` 覆盖该路径。

3. 详情阅读没有读到底：
   - Failure：滚动一次返回 `no_effect/at_boundary` 时，旧逻辑可能过早停止，导致右侧详情未读完整。
   - Root invariant：长读停止必须由内容重复确认或真实 bottom 证据触发；单次滚动无变化不能直接等价于到底。
   - Fix location：`scripts/seek_debug_step_runner.py`。批量阅读滚动的最大自适应力度提高到 20；只有 `bottom_reached` 立即停止，`no_effect` 会继续采样并要求连续无新增内容确认。
   - Regression：`test_read_detail_batch_confirms_no_effect_before_bottom` 覆盖“第一次 no_effect 后仍继续滚动/采样”。

验证：

### 2026-06-25 Apply candidate freshness before SEEK apply entry

本轮收口真实 SEEK smoke 暴露的 Apply 入口慢和漂移问题：

1. Failure：详情批量阅读后，`apply_button_state` 只要带旧 bbox/click point，runner 就跳过“右侧详情回到顶部”，导致底部或旧截图里的 Apply 候选可能进入执行层，后续又触发 pre-apply verification 失败和多分钟重试。
2. Root invariant violated：`open_apply_flow` 候选必须来自当前截图，并带 `candidate_freshness.capture_id`、`viewport_size` 和稳定区域证据；不能混用旧截图坐标和新截图验证。
3. Fix location：`scripts/seek_mvp_traversal_runner.py`。新增 `_apply_state_stability()`，只有当前截图、带 capture id、带 viewport，并且 click point 不贴近视口底部的 Apply 候选才允许跳过 detail reset。
4. Why not SEEK-only：这是通用 candidate freshness / detail scope 合约。任何 GUI 里的固定按钮快路径都必须证明点位属于当前截图和当前容器，不能仅凭历史 bbox 授权。
5. Regression：`tests/test_seek_mvp_traversal_runner.py::test_execute_apply_entry_resets_when_apply_candidate_is_bottom_stale` 覆盖底部旧 Apply 候选必须先滚回详情顶部；既有 seeded-candidate 测试补充 freshness 证据后仍走快路径。
6. Safety impact：没有放宽 Gate 或 final submit guard；Apply 仍是 `open_apply_flow`，`Submit` / `Send` / `Confirm` / payment 仍必须强拦。

## Runtime State

- Date: 2026-06-24. Learn Mode now automatically crops stable button/icon visual assets from `screen_map.candidates` during `POST /vision/observe_screen` when `agent_mode=learn`. The new `visual_asset_learning_v1` output writes tight/context crops, source capture id, source bbox/click point, match policy, scope, semantic action, danger level, and `can_authorize_click=false`; dynamic job/news/result cards are skipped. Execute recognition planning now consumes these assets through `visual_asset_recall_v1`: it matches learned crops against the current screenshot, emits a fresh `seeded_candidate_v1` with current `capture_id`, viewport, bbox, click point, source, and freshness, then sends the candidate through the existing Gate. Low-risk fixed controls such as `Quick apply` can skip the slow VISTA point model when the current visual match is strong; route-level regression now proves `POST /vision/recognition_plan` sets `visual_asset_fast_lane_used=true`, writes ROI/match crop evidence, leaves `model_io.status=skipped`, and still returns `pre_click_decision.allowed=true` through Gate. `final_submit` / `send` / `confirm` / payment assets are matched as evidence only and never enter the fast lane. The matcher now records gray-template and edge-template evidence, multi-scale matching, top candidates, top1/top2 score gap, `current_roi_ref`, and `current_match_ref`; synthetic regression covers a scaled button and asserts visual matching finishes under one second. Trace Inspector now exposes this as a `Visual Assets` stage and treats `template_path`, `current_roi_ref`, and `current_match_ref` as previewable image evidence.
- Date: 2026-06-24. SEEK manual-learning export now carries observed Apply / Quick apply visual-control samples into the runtime graph as `visual_asset_samples`. `build_visual_asset_crop_export()` uses those samples to crop real button templates instead of leaving Apply assets as `pending_no_learned_bbox`; the exported assets keep `semantic_action=open_apply_flow`, `danger_level=low`, `can_authorize_click=false`, source bbox/click point, and crop hashes. Local no-mouse smoke `uv run python scripts\visual_asset_local_smoke.py --out-dir artifacts\visual-match-smoke\local_seek_buttons` generated a synthetic SEEK screenshot, cropped Quick apply / Apply buttons plus a high-risk Submit application button, matched Quick apply from the learned crop in `8.822ms`, produced `safe_open_apply_flow`, matched Submit application in `10.639ms` as `potential_side_effect_action`, and wrote ROI/match evidence under `artifacts\visual-match-smoke\local_seek_buttons`. The smoke writes `visual_asset_calibration_report_v1` with `case_count=8`, `matched_count=3`, `fast_lane_success_count=2`, `high_risk_match_count=1`, `final_submit_fast_lane_count=0`, `final_submissions=0`, and `status=pass`. A regression now proves duplicate similar low-risk buttons with insufficient top1/top2 score gap are marked `ambiguous` and cannot enter fast lane. It also writes `learned_interface_map_v1` to `artifacts\visual-match-smoke\local_seek_buttons\learned_interface_map.json`, grouping the learned page into 6 regions, 8 fixed visual assets, 3 dynamic ROI areas, and 1 danger zone. `merge_visual_asset_match_evidence()` now writes current-capture match evidence back into the matching fixed visual asset, including `current_roi_ref`, `current_match_ref`, match score, top1/top2 gap, current bbox/click point, method, elapsed time, and candidate freshness, while preserving `artifact_is_authorization=false`. The Learn Replay panel now has a first editable `learned_interface_map_v1` viewer and Inspector: it loads the interface map artifact, shows state/region summaries, fixed visual assets with crop thumbnails, dynamic ROI areas, and final-submit danger zones; the operator can click Inspect on any region, fixed visual asset, dynamic ROI area, or danger zone to see source crop, source image, current ROI/current match, bbox/click point, scope, match policy, semantic action, danger level, fast-lane eligibility, and raw JSON. The operator can edit region label/type and fixed-asset semantic action, danger level, and region, then save to `artifacts\interface-maps\` through `/panel/save_interface_map`. Saving writes `learned_interface_map_edit_trace_v1`, keeps `can_authorize_click=false`, and does not change final-submit safety. The redesigned Learn Mode path-graph panel direction is documented in `docs\LEARN_PATH_GRAPH_PANEL_REDESIGN.zh-CN.md`: large state/region map, fixed visual assets, dynamic ROI areas, inspector evidence, and manual editing. The new direction allows replacing the old flat PathGraph UI with a state/region canvas where fixed buttons use screenshot matching and dynamic areas use bounded ROI model calls.

Regression coverage: `tests\test_execute_recognition_plan_route.py` now proves unstructured final-submit metadata is blocked before any click; `tests\test_seek_pre_submit_audit.py` proves the SEEK pre-submit audit blocks unsupported/needs-review cases and allows reviewed strong-apply cases.

The project currently has a working recognition MVP over saved screenshots plus the first controlled execution endpoint for live bound-window captures.

Working path:

1. Run OCR over the screenshot and build high-confidence `ocr_anchors_v1` text-coordinate hints for the recognition-plan path.
2. Analyze the screenshot through the configured local vision provider, with a bounded OCR geometry projection included in precise prompts when available.
3. Run or reuse OCR over the same screenshot.
4. Build `page_structure_v1` from semantic regions and OCR boxes.
5. Build `screen_reading_v1` when a READ-facing UI description is needed.
6. Rank executable elements against the user goal.
7. Crop the top candidates and rerun local OCR.
8. Map the matched local OCR center back to full-image coordinates.
9. Decide whether the candidate is safe enough for a click.
10. Render an overlay for human review.
11. Optionally execute the selected click point through `POST /action/execute_recognition_plan` when the plan was built from a live capture and `pre_click_decision.allowed == true`.
12. Capture post-click evidence through the existing verifier.

## Agent API Workflow

- `AGENT_API_WORKFLOW.md` now defines the required API-first upper-layer agent workflow.
- Live agents should call `POST /runtime/prepare`, discover/open or bind the app, `GET /state`, then `POST /action/execute_recognition_plan` with `dry_run=true` before any real click.
- The dry-run action path captures the live window, calls `POST /vision/recognition_plan` internally, retains full OCR anchors for trace/evaluation and sends a bounded precision-prompt projection, returns `recognition_plan_v1`, renders overlay evidence when possible, and exposes `pre_click_decision_v1`.
- Agents must execute only through `POST /action/execute_recognition_plan` and must not click raw `vision_regions_v1` bboxes.
- Agent-facing specs now recommend preserving the user's original instruction in metadata while sending normalized English `goal`, `state_hint`, and negative constraints to vision-model routes. A real Google search-result rerun with English model-facing fields passed the formal pre-click gate and clicked the first organic result, while the earlier mixed/garbled Chinese request caused the model to target `AI Overview`.
- The desktop test panel has a distinct human-review path: it fills the first localization candidate into bbox and click-point fields, and only an explicit operator action calls `POST /action/execute_confirmed_point`.
- The intended live workflow now begins with app discovery: `GET /apps` tells the agent which configured apps can be launched, what capabilities they advertise, which windows are visible, and what is currently bound.
- Browser app launch can now append a `url`, and the app catalog can carry `executable_candidates` so Edge/Chrome launches do not depend only on PATH.
- `POST /action/type_text` provides a real input API for bound windows, using SendInput plus clipboard paste, with optional focus click, clear-existing, submit, and dry-run modes.
- Runtime/app/vision/action agent paths now return `timings` with `runtime_timing_v1`, `total_ms`, and per-step `elapsed_ms` entries. Recognition plans break out image loading, OCR anchor preparation, model inference, normalization, page structure, UIA, screen reading, ranking, local grounding, and the pre-click gate; action execution also records live capture, overlay rendering, click dispatch, and verification stages.
- `POST /action/execute_recognition_plan` now supports approved-plan reuse: a successful dry-run writes `approved_recognition_plan_v1` under `logs/approved-plans/` and returns `approved_plan_id`; a later real execution with that ID validates the same bound window, goal, TTL, and click point, then skips the second large-model recognition pass.
- `POST /action/execute_recognition_plan` also has the first instruction-learning slice: `learning_mode="instruction"` writes `learned_instruction_v1` after a verified real click, and a later call with `learned_instruction_id` reuses the stored point after exact same-goal/app/window-handle/window-size validation. New learning writes a permanent local bundle under `artifacts/local-learning/instructions/{id}/` with the JSON record, source screenshot, pre/post screenshots, diff image, and target crop; reuse skips recognition/model inference, but still dispatches through the normal input controller and runs post-click verification.
