This prevents a successful status-list request from leaving the UI green while the selected model service itself is not ready.
- Date: 2026-06-12. Fixed the direct precise-localization preflight failure where the browser panel could send `wait_seconds=180` to `POST /runtime/models/start` while `ModelServerRequest` still capped the field at `120`, causing FastAPI to return `422` before Locate could run. Runtime model-start and prepare request contracts now accept `0..180` seconds, matching the panel's local-model startup preflight.
- Date: 2026-06-09. Model input/output tracing is now first-class. `LocalVisionProvider` records `model_io_attempt_v1` for every OpenAI-compatible local model attempt, including the full prompt text, source/inference image paths, max tokens, raw model text, raw endpoint response, parsed model JSON, runtime-normalized JSON, and parse errors. `POST /vision/analyze`, `/vision/page_structure`, `/vision/screen_reading`, `/vision/observe_screen`, and `/vision/recognition_plan` attach `model_io_trace_v1` to success traces and preserve failed model diagnostics in failure traces. RecognitionPlan also keeps failed anchored-provider attempts under `model_io_failovers` when the fallback retry succeeds. Trace Inspector renders this as a `Model IO` stage.
- Date: 2026-06-09. Fixed the main cause of local-understanding JSON failures. The Qwen3-VL 8B observe prompt was capped at `max_tokens=1024`, and Google News screen-reading responses were consistently truncated around the final region (`"confidence": 0.`), producing `Expecting ',' delimiter`. `LocalVisionProvider._max_output_tokens()` now uses `2048` for `task="observe_screen"`, the system/observe prompts explicitly require comma separators, escaped string quotes/newlines, and no trailing commas, and the parser can repair missing commas, trailing commas, raw newlines, inner quotes, and truncated `regions` arrays. A 10-run `/vision/screen_reading` smoke on the failing Google News screenshot passed 10/10 after the fix.
- Date: 2026-06-09. Observe now has an OCR/UIA degraded fallback for local model JSON failures. If `screen_reading` fails because the local vision endpoint returns invalid JSON, `POST /vision/observe_screen` no longer returns the failed screen-reading response directly. It builds `screen_observation_v1` with `status="degraded"`, keeps the original error under `degraded_reason`, scans OCR text into `texts`, builds `screen_map_v1`, and marks `execution_path.degraded_observe_fallback_used=true`. The map remains observation evidence only and still requires Locate/RecognitionPlan/Gate before any click.
- Date: 2026-06-09. Fixed app/window listing in the browser panel. A misplaced `_is_candidate_window` block in `app/core/window_manager.py` caused every visible top-level window to be filtered out, so `/apps.running_windows` and `/session/windows` returned empty lists. The filter now correctly accepts visible titled top-level windows. The panel also renders `/apps.data.catalog.apps` in a separate App catalog dropdown/datalist, so `List apps` shows catalog apps even when no windows are currently visible.
- Date: 2026-06-09. Learn Deep now has the second-stage model review hook. `POST /vision/observe_screen` with `learn_depth="deep"` first builds the deterministic PathGraph review, then calls the configured local model with task `learn_deep_review` unless `metadata.learn_deep_model_review=false`. The model returns `learn_deep_model_review_v1`; its add/remove/update decisions are conservatively merged into `path_graph_deep_review_v1` and `path_graph_delta_v1`, with the raw model review status stored under `path_graph_deep_review.model_review`. Model failure falls back to deterministic review instead of failing Observe.
- Date: 2026-06-09. Execute Mode now has a closed MVP loop. `POST /action/execute_recognition_plan` writes `execute_transition_memory_v1` after verified real clicks when `write_policy.element_memory=true`, storing goal, selected candidate, click point, traces, verification evidence, bound-window snapshot, and PathGraph recall evidence in the existing transition memory store. Pre-click rejection, recognition failure, click exceptions, and post-click verification failure now return `execute_fallback_plan_v1`, which plans local rescan / PathGraph review / full OCR refresh / gated model regrounding without auto-clicking. Trace Inspector renders `Memory` and `Fallback` stages.
- Date: 2026-06-09. Learn Deep has a runnable observe-stage MVP. `VisionObserveScreenRequestModel(learn_depth="deep")` defaults to `{path_graph:true, element_memory:true, trace:true}` when no explicit write policy is supplied. `POST /vision/observe_screen` emits `path_graph_deep_review_v1`, `path_graph_delta_v1`, and `element_memory_init_plan_v1`; the deterministic pass removes near-duplicate PathGraph candidates, records per-candidate decisions, updates `screen_map.summary`, and prepares ElementMemory init entries without treating them as verified execution memory. Trace Inspector renders the result as `Path Deep`.
- Date: 2026-06-08. Bound-window screenshots now wait `0.5` seconds after foreground activation before capture. This targets early captures where Edge is still restoring or the page is still settling without changing browser open wait policy. Window-title matching now ignores invisible Unicode format-control characters, fixing Edge titles such as `Microsoft​ Edge` that previously failed a normal `Microsoft Edge` bind. The local vision provider also performs a narrow repair for otherwise valid JSON that contains unescaped quotes inside string values, recording `json_repair=escaped_inner_string_quotes` in notes when used.
- Date: 2026-06-09. Execute-mode planning now pushes PathGraph recall into the actionable recognition chain. `path_graph_recall_v1` candidates are converted into normal `RecognitionCandidate` objects, deduped with vision/page-structure candidates, ranked into `candidate_result`, and passed to local OCR grounding and `pre_click_decision_v1`. Only `risk_class=safe_click_allowed` recall candidates are eligible; other recalled map candidates remain blocked by the gate. A route test now covers a case where the vision model returns no target region, PathGraph recall supplies `Launch dashboard`, local crop OCR grounds it, and the pre-click gate selects `path_graph_launch_btn`.
- Date: 2026-06-08. Execute-mode planning now has the first real PathGraph recall slice. `VisionRecognitionPlanRequestModel` and `ExecuteRecognitionPlanRequest` accept `observe_trace_path`; action execution passes it into the internal recognition plan. Matching Observe traces provide reusable OCR anchors and `screen_map_v1`; recognition planning emits `path_graph_recall_v1` with state match, top recalled candidates, scores, and local OCR ROI hints. Trace Inspector renders this as `Path Recall`. Reused OCR anchors are converted back into `OCRResult` for page-structure fusion so the recognition-plan full-image OCR step is skipped; candidate crop OCR still runs during local grounding.
- Date: 2026-06-08. The panel and request models now carry the Learn/Execute architecture boundary. `agent_mode`, `learn_depth`, and `write_policy` are accepted by Observe, Locate, Recognition Plan, and Execute Recognition Plan. The panel adds `Learn Mode / Execute Mode` plus `Learn Fast / Learn Deep` controls. Learn Fast defaults to `{path_graph:true, element_memory:false, trace:true}`, Learn Deep to `{path_graph:true, element_memory:true, trace:true}`, and Execute to `{path_graph:false, element_memory:true, trace:true}`. Panel PathGraph ingest respects `write_policy.path_graph`, instruction learning respects `write_policy.element_memory`, and the main Observe/Locate/RecognitionPlan/ExecuteRecognitionPlan trace writes respect `write_policy.trace`.
- Date: 2026-06-08. `POST /vision/locate_target` now returns `path_map_review_v1` when it can reuse an Observe trace with `screen_map_v1`. The review compares Locate's AI/candidate evidence against the previous path map, emits additions for missing precise candidates, and emits scoped removals for same-label or high-overlap stale candidates. The web panel applies the review to the current path graph without deleting clicked controls or controls already linked to a next page, saves `candidate_id` in path graph controls, and Trace Inspector shows the review as a `Path Review` stage.
- Date: 2026-06-08. `screen_map_v1` now applies explicit map-building rules before precise localization: every valid OCR text inside `page_header` becomes a `nav_text_action` candidate, and related OCR text in `main_content`, `promo_strip`, or `lower_content` is grouped into `source="ocr_card_groups"` card-level candidates with bbox covering the whole card. Trace Inspector's `Path Map` detail now opens with a dynamic state/section/candidate path graph generated from the whole-screen map, then renders the section list before candidates and shows each candidate's source/rule metadata.
- Date: 2026-06-08. `POST /vision/locate_target` can now reuse OCR anchors from a previous Observe trace via `observe_trace_path` when the analyzed screenshot matches. The panel stores the latest Observe trace and includes it in Locate/Execute recognition-plan requests, so the normal Observe -> Locate flow avoids a second full-image OCR anchor scan on the same image and reports reuse status in `observe_trace_reuse`; candidate crop OCR can still run during local grounding.
- Date: 2026-06-07. Documentation-only update: `LEARNING_MODE_PLAN.zh-CN.md` now defines two first-class learning modes. `exploration_learning` is the active self-exploration mode for safely mapping interface states and low-risk transitions. `path_recording_learning` is the passive record-after-click mode for saving every real gated click as a verified path event with before/after screenshots, traces, target evidence, gate decision, and verification result. Existing `instruction_learning` is documented as a promoted reusable artifact from verified path events rather than a separate unrestricted learning mode.
- Date: 2026-06-07. First learning-map MVP slice: `POST /vision/observe_screen` now derives `screen_map_v1` from the screen-reading result. The map carries a deterministic state id, state hint, screen summary, candidate action list, risk class, expected effect, and bbox/click-point hints. The browser panel path graph now consumes `screen_map.candidates` during Observe, so the existing navigation-path card is seeded by the whole-screen understanding stage before precise localization. These coordinates are not executable; Locate and the gated action API remain required before real clicks.
- Date: 2026-06-07. Trace Inspector now parses observe traces containing `screen_map_v1` into a `Path Map` flow stage. Clicking that stage shows a compact path-candidate list, the raw map JSON, and screenshot overlay evidence from candidate bbox/click_point fields. A MouseTester path-map smoke trace was generated at `logs/traces/vision/20260607-160746-689126__observe-screen__mousetesterweb-path-map-smoke.json`; the live model-backed observe route was not rerun because local model ports `1234` and `1240` were unreachable.
- Date: 2026-06-07. `screen_map_v1` now includes page sections and assigns candidates to `section_id` values such as `page_header`, `promo_strip`, `main_content`, `lower_content`, and `floating_overlay`. It also supplements broad-vision candidates with high-confidence OCR text action/card candidates, so MouseTester body cards such as `按键与滚轮`, `回报率测试`, `双击测试`, `点击此处测试`, `点击开始检测`, `平滑度`, `左键`, `中键`, and `右键` appear in the map. Live framework test against `https://www.mousetester.cn` passed with `31` candidates, `6` sections, and `18` `main_content` candidates; trace: `logs/traces/vision/20260607-162403-001742__observe-screen__mousetesterweb.json`.
- Date: 2026-06-05. The web panel now treats browser launch IDs such as `edge`, `chrome`, `msedge`, `firefox`, and `browser` as launch modes rather than target app names. Observe/locate/execute app fields auto-sync from the URL or selected window instead; `https://www.mousetester.cn` maps to `MouseTesterWeb`, so browser startup does not overwrite the actual app context with `edge`. Window titles are also parsed into app context and state context: browser suffixes such as `- Microsoft Edge` are removed, `MouseTester` titles canonicalize to `MouseTesterWeb`, and the text after the app segment is synced into the observe/locate state hint.
- Date: 2026-06-05. The panel no longer hardcodes a MouseTester URL, observe app, or state hint in the initial form. Open/bind starts with empty URL/app/state fields; selecting a visible window fills `App ID` from `process_name` (`msedge.exe -> edge`, `chrome.exe -> chrome`, otherwise the lowercased process name without `.exe`) and then syncs the selected window title into the observe/locate shared app/state fields. After binding, locate should only require the target goal to be typed manually.
- Date: 2026-06-05. Window-title state sync now also handles non-browser/non-canonical apps: if the selected window title cannot be split as `AppName - State`, the full selected window title is used as the state hint instead of leaving a stale browser-panel state. For example, a selected `Locus.exe#12056 | 我让deepseek...` window syncs `app_name=locus` and `state_hint=我让deepseek...`.
- Date: 2026-06-05. Trace Inspector now attaches the recognition-plan `image_path` to Candidates, Gate, and Target stage raw sections so stage detail can render the screenshot with candidate boxes and selected points. Gate block summaries now read `pre_click_decision.reasons`, `summary`, and `candidate_decisions`, not only the legacy single `reason` field, so blocked locate traces explain why a dry-run was refused.
- Date: 2026-06-05. Locate-target trace parsing now reads OCR and vision data from nested `recognition_plan.parse_result` as well as top-level `parse_result`, so `target_location_v1` traces show the OCR stage when OCR actually ran. Trace image previews draw thicker bbox/point overlays with labels, and Gate stage raw includes the candidate result so blocked Gate details can render candidate boxes together with the selected/located point.
- Date: 2026-06-05. The Execute page keeps coordinate inputs visible and simplifies the four action buttons into explicit preview/execute pairs: `Plan Click Preview`, `Plan Execute Click`, `Point Click Preview`, and `Point Execute Click`. Preview still means `dry_run=true`: generate the plan/trace/rendered evidence without dispatching a real click. Execute means `dry_run=false`: dispatch the click path after the relevant gate allows it.
- Page-structure fusion now grounds text-bearing targets from matched OCR coordinates and records `unreferenced_text_contamination` when the larger semantic bbox contains unrelated OCR outside the target text cluster. Those contaminated text targets stay as confirmation-required `precise_text_target` review candidates.
- OCR-grounded text candidates no longer derive or enforce an `above_exclusion_boundary` from the nearest aligned text above the selected target. Neighboring upper text is not a special hard boundary; unrelated OCR inside the larger semantic bbox is handled by the contamination evidence instead.
- Date: 2026-05-27. A real no-click rerun on the saved Seek/Serato screenshot returned a candidate at `located_bbox={x:58,y:649,w:276,h:51}` and `located_point={x:196,y:674}`, matching the visible Serato title/company text instead of the earlier upward-drifting visual card bbox. It returned `location_status=requires_pre_click_confirmation`, `pre_click_decision.allowed=false`, and executed no action. The dense-page anchored attempt used fallback, so the default 48-row budget is not universally within context. Trace: `logs/traces/vision/20260527-191108-902171__locate-target__browser.json`.
- Date: 2026-05-31. The aligned upper OCR boundary experiment was removed from the runtime. Serato-style text targets now rely on OCR-derived target coordinates and normal policy gates rather than a hard preceding-row exclusion boundary.
- `POST /action/execute_recognition_plan` is implemented as `execute_recognition_plan_v1`.
- Saved screenshots are dry-run/override-only by default; live bound-window capture is the normal execution path.
- The endpoint refuses to click when `pre_click_decision_v1` rejects the plan.
- The endpoint writes an action trace and attempts to render a recognition-plan overlay for every accepted plan.
- Post-click verification now combines the generic screenshot diff/focus verifier with MouseTester-specific semantic verification when the target app is MouseTester.
- MouseTester semantic verification checks OCR text near the selected target before/after the click and requires target-area diff evidence.
- Execution retry policy is now attached to `POST /action/execute_recognition_plan`.
- Retries are limited by `max_execution_attempts` and only happen after retry-safe post-click verification failures, not after pre-click rejection or candidate/text mismatch.
- A trace-based MouseTester evaluation set is available through `scripts/evaluate_mousetester_traces.py`.
- A repeatable UIA smoke recorder/evaluator is available through `scripts/record_uia_smoke.py`.
- `POST /vision/screen_reading` now exposes a separate READ-facing UI layer. It promotes OCR-backed page elements, preserves visual-only/icon candidates as conservative reserved targets, groups modules, connects a Windows UIA scanner, and reserves provider slots for future browser accessibility and learned-UI memory integrations.
- The earlier Microsoft Fluent icon-catalog matcher has been removed; icon-like candidates remain visible in `ui.icon_candidates`, but they no longer receive catalog ids or catalog-based ranking evidence.
- The connected UIA scanner can enumerate the currently bound window and merge overlapping accessibility controls such as `name=Back`, `control_type=Button`, and `patterns=["Invoke"]` into screen-reading elements and icon candidates.
- UIA pattern probing now skips unavailable pywinauto descriptors instead of failing the whole scan when a control does not expose a queried pattern.
- `POST /vision/recognition_plan` now builds `screen_reading_v1` and passes it into `candidate_rank_v1`; UIA accessible names and overlapping UIA controls can improve goal matching and contribute `screen_reading_score`.
- `POST /vision/recognition_plan` now builds complete `ocr_anchors_v1` evidence before the provider call; `click_target` prompts project it as `relation_matrix_compact` evidence capped at `48` anchors by default, preserving the text and bbox of each selected anchor and asking returned grounded targets to cite a relevant row in `anchor_relations`.
- Where OCR has a strong goal-text match, precision projection now spends up to `12` rows of the same budget on nearby same-row/same-column text layout and emits compact `focus_relation_rows`; callers can override this with `metadata.ocr_anchors.prompt_focus_neighbor_limit`.
- The local provider scales OCR anchors into the actual inference image size when it resizes a screenshot; if the anchored provider request fails, recognition planning retries once without anchors and records fallback state in `execution_path`.
- The local provider now recovers out-of-bounds Qwen-style `0..1000` coordinates before resize remapping and records `coordinate_space_recovered=normalized_1000` in notes.
- The precision prompt now sends selected anchors as dense `i,t,x,y,w,h,m` matrix rows plus inclusion/exclusion policy rows, while full OCR records remain available downstream for review and grounding evaluation. Single-character partial matches such as title-bar `鍙 in `鍏抽棴绐楀彛` remain useful context but do not set the goal-match bit.
- The prompt builder now appends `metadata.prompt_overrides.additional_rules`, allowing the desktop settings panel or an agent request to test extra grounding rules without editing `app/vision/prompting.py`.
- Precise target localization now includes an adjacent text/icon rule for small visual targets: if the goal names text next to a small icon, the model must first identify the text target and adjacent icon as a paired reference, then localize only the requested clickable target. For visual-only adjacent icons, the final icon bbox must not overlap the text bbox; text is used only as an anchor, boundary, and negative constraint. The same rule is present in the browser panel default Locate prompt and the saved panel config.
- The fixed response panel now renders an animated action path graph from the latest API response. It turns goal, screen capture, OCR/UIA/vision evidence, candidate ranking, narrow search, pre-click gate, approved plan reuse, target point, click, verification, timings, and trace artifacts into a node-link view for faster execution review.
- `ACTION_PATH_GRAPH_SPEC.zh-CN.md` now defines the planned persisted `runtime_path_graph_v1` contract. The rule is deterministic generation from API responses/traces; AI may summarize or translate labels, but it must not invent nodes, edges, click points, or verification outcomes.
- Candidate-box manual generation and its preview now live in the precise-localization page rather than the screenshot page; capture remains focused on acquiring and previewing source images.
- A successful localization response now fills its first candidate into the bbox-review fields and the click-gate center point. The gate includes coordinate dry-run and operator-confirmed real-click actions through `execute_confirmed_point_v1`.
- The browser panel navigation-path widget now uses stable Segoe UI / Microsoft YaHei toolbar and canvas fonts, with fixed left/center/right toolbar alignment. Page Detail expands the selected page into possible actions, possible entries/navigation, and all discovered buttons/inputs/controls, collecting controls from current and legacy observe/screen-reading result shapes such as `ui.elements`, `screen_reading.*`, `parse_result.screen_reading.*`, `page_structure.elements`, and `vision_regions.regions`.
- The browser Trace inspector no longer serializes missing metadata as `?`. Legacy recognition-overlay traces are inferred as `recognition_overlay_trace`, parsed into request/capture/overlay stages, and absent total-time/provider fields are left empty for the UI to render as explicit "not recorded" metadata.
- Trace stage detail cards now scan each stage's raw JSON for image path fields such as `image_path`, `output_path`, screenshots, overlays, and crops. When a stage also contains bbox or click/selected-point coordinates, the browser panel renders those boxes and points over the image; missing image files show an explicit "image does not exist" message instead of a broken preview.
- The Trace dropdown now filters out traces that reference pytest temporary paths by default, so local UI history is not polluted by test-generated traces whose `capture.png` files were deleted with the pytest temp directory. The `include_tests=true` query parameter remains available for debugging those test traces directly.
- The browser panel now preflights selected local model profiles before running Observe or Locate. If the chosen local understanding/grounding service is not reachable, the panel calls `POST /runtime/models/start` and waits for `/v1/models`; if the service still is not ready, it shows a model-preflight error instead of immediately writing a misleading vision failure trace. Failed screen-reading traces that already exist are parsed into request/capture/error stages, using `request.image_path` for the capture stage and preserving the original endpoint error in the Error stage.
- The browser panel model Start/Stop buttons are null-safe after the old `prepareWait` control was removed from the UI. Clicking a model action now immediately renders a `panel_model_action_v1` status response, then calls `/runtime/models/start` or `/runtime/models/stop`; the missing `prepareWait.checked` reference no longer aborts the click handler.
- The browser panel now synchronizes app/state fields across Observe, Locate, and Execute. Selecting a window, opening/binding an app, or receiving an observe-screen response fills `observeApp`, `locateApp`, and `executeApp` from the bound app/window, and fills `observeState` / `locateState` from `state_guess` or `suggested_state_hint` so precise localization automatically inherits the latest screen-understanding state.
- The model controls on screen-understanding and precise-localization pages now show inline service status. A start action reports immediately, skips duplicate launch when `/v1/models` already responds, and the service-check action reports loaded model or connection failure in the same page.
- Model startup warm-up is now treated as a transient state: the panel reports llama.cpp `HTTP 503: Loading model` as loading and does not launch a duplicate process, while `LocalVisionProvider` waits and retries the same inference attempt until the configured timeout instead of failing the workflow immediately.
- Saved panel configs that predate the state-hint rule are migrated at load time by appending the `state_guess` -> precise `state_hint` instruction, so existing local `configs/settings_panel.json` files get the new behavior without manual edits.
- The prompt builder now routes `click_target` requests through a single-target precision template instead of the general whole-screen-region template. This prevents the large model from spending its output window describing unrelated controls; in the latest icon smoke it generated one candidate and completed without truncation.
- The browser panel mirrors those registry controls: model dropdowns are populated from `GET /runtime/models`, observe defaults to the `understanding` role, locate defaults to the `grounding` role, and selected profiles drive provider mode plus `POST /runtime/models/start` / `POST /runtime/models/stop` payloads.
- Local model configuration is split into two profiles: `vision.local_understanding` for the smaller model used by `POST /vision/observe_screen`, and `vision.local_grounding` for the larger model used by `POST /vision/locate_target` and dry-run gated execution.
- `POST /state/capture_window` still uses screen-coordinate MSS capture, but now lightly restores the bound window, attempts to bring it to the foreground, and waits briefly before grabbing pixels. It does not block on a foreground verification gate.
- Current local-model split: `Qwen3-VL 8B Q4_K_M` is the launchable default for Learn Mode / whole-screen observation, `Qwen3-VL 4B Q4_K_M` is the fast understanding option, and `VISTA-4B Transformers` is the default point-grounding model for locate/execute. Historical Qwen3.6 35B grounding experiments are no longer the active baseline.
- The local provider/panel timeout remains conservative for local vision requests, but Execute Mode performance work should prefer preprocessing, PathGraph/ROI recall, and VISTA max-edge controls over simply increasing timeout ceilings.
- Latest local-understanding experiment: `Qwen3-VL 4B Q4_K_M` loaded through llama.cpp b8892 on the local RTX 4070 SUPER path with its Qwen3-VL mmproj and completed the 3-case understanding benchmark faster than the 8B baseline.
- MiniCPM-V-4.6 direct Transformers inference can read small screenshots quickly enough for benchmarks, but current llama.cpp cannot serve it through the existing OpenAI-compatible script because the projector type is unsupported.
- `vision_regions_v1` now preserves `anchor_relations` and `grounding_constraints` for each region, so model output can show which OCR anchors constrained the visual bbox and how they set bbox edges, center alignment, expected size, exclusions, and the final coordinate reason before coordinates are consumed downstream.
- OCR-assisted grounding now separates two coordinate policies: visual-only icons must use nearby text boxes as boundary-line rulers while excluding text boxes from the final bbox, and text-bearing controls must include the referenced OCR text boxes in the final bbox.
- Recognition planning now writes `grounding_constraints.grounding_evaluation` for regions that reference known OCR anchors, recording whether the returned bbox obeyed the include/exclude policy and suggesting `anchor_corrected_bbox` when referenced text was missed.
- The default local visual stack no longer uses the old Qwen3.6 35B profile. Whole-screen understanding and precise point grounding are split across smaller Qwen3-VL understanding models and VISTA point grounding.
- The local provider requests JSON-object output and caps precise-grounding responses at 2048 tokens. `observe_screen` now uses a compact candidate contract capped at 1024 tokens: OCR coordinates remain available as read-only input evidence, but the understanding model is explicitly told not to emit OCR copies, anchor relations, or detailed grounding constraints. The parser can repair unescaped quotes inside JSON string values and marks that path with `json_repair=escaped_inner_string_quotes`. The default Qwen3-VL 8B understanding profile uses an 8192-token context; the 4B profile remains available for faster runs.
- The vision normalizer now detects small-image responses that use Qwen-style 0-1000 coordinates and scales them back to real screenshot pixels before clamping.
- Screen-reading rank evidence remains bounded: blocked/ad-like interaction policy still rejects candidates even when UIA evidence matches the goal.

## Current Accuracy Improvements

- Far repeated OCR fragments are no longer bound into one element unless local geometry supports the binding.
- Short ambiguous OCR text no longer overrides semantic-only coordinates when it is far from the semantic region.
- OCR anchors now give the visual model an earlier coordinate reference for text-adjacent icons, buttons, inputs, and cards before page-structure fusion runs.
- Latest MouseTester experiment with all 58 OCR anchors reached the model without fallback, but the returned mouse-illustration bbox still drifted left; this points toward local crop/ROI grounding rather than only adding more global text anchors.
- A follow-up MouseTester run with the revised prompt returned `anchor_relations` for the mouse illustration, including the title above and the `宸﹂敭/涓敭/鍙抽敭` labels below; the relation evidence is now inspectable even when the bbox is imperfect.
- The grounding prompt now asks for a stronger locating system instead of only above/below/left/right: reference frame, edge constraints, center constraints, size constraints, negative constraints, and final bbox reason.
- Latest post-change MouseTester route smoke sent `77/77` compact OCR anchors, used anchored grounding without fallback, and produced `grounding_constraints`; this remains the A/B baseline for comparing local multimodal backends.
- Latest Qwen3.6 IQ4_XS OCR-anchor test shows the anchor idea is most valuable for small icons: the browser Back icon moved from a wrong pure-vision location to a well-centered OCR-assisted location, although its bbox remained too tight.
- Candidate bbox refinement prefers OCR text that matches the current goal.
- Candidate ranking now uses `screen_reading_v1` provider evidence when available.
- Narrow search crops the refined bbox when available.
- Pre-click decision requires candidate-goal text match, local OCR match, candidate policy approval, margin confidence, and point-in-bbox validity.

## Strategic Direction

Long-term goal: build toward an agent that can operate unknown pages by observing, planning, executing, validating, and recovering.

Current stage: Single-page stable loop. MouseTester is the fixed website and `鐐瑰嚮姝ゅ娴嬭瘯` is the fixed task. The golden baseline shows the system is succeeding through structured reasoning, not random coordinate luck.

Current capability inside this stage: successful verified `execute_recognition_plan` runs now write `execute_transition_memory_v1` when `write_policy.element_memory=true`. The record connects goal, target evidence, click point, verification result, recognition trace, action trace, bound window, and PathGraph recall evidence. Promotion from transition memory into broader reusable strategies remains future work.

Next stage: Cross-session stability. The same fixed task needs to work across repeated sessions, light page changes, window-size changes, DPI/display scaling changes, OCR fluctuation, visual-model fluctuation, browser reloads, zoom changes, and focus/scroll differences.

Later stages: semantic generalization across equivalent labels such as `寮€濮嬫祴閫焋, `Launch Test`, `Run Benchmark`, and `Start`; multi-step stateful workflows; then recovery and self-healing when the expected UI or validation result does not appear.

## Known Limitations

- The local vision model can vary between runs; the current safety design handles bad candidates by rejection and retry-safe verification failures by bounded retry.
- The current evaluation set is trace-based and small; it should be expanded with more MouseTester states.
- `screen_reading_v1` has a connected Windows UIA provider, but browser accessibility providers and icon shape-template verification are not connected yet.
- Current validation is strong for MouseTester saved screenshots, not yet broad across many websites or applications.
- Windows UIA live quality is now recorded as trace/evaluation evidence for Edge/MouseTester, but UIA-to-vision merging still needs broader route evidence from real screenshots and more apps.

### 2026-06-13 Learn PathGraph 子路径图更新

导航路径图现在会把当前页面的控件渲染成子路径图：页面节点是主节点，搜索框、按钮、导航文字等控件是子节点，点击页面节点可展开/收起，点击子节点会打开同一页面详情并高亮对应控件。Learn Mode 下点击精准定位会发送 `metadata.learn_all_targets=true`，后端从最近 Observe trace 的 `screen_map.candidates` 生成 `learn_all_targets`，把所有子控件的 `bbox/click_point` 写入 locate trace 和 `path_map_review`，不再要求用户提供单个点击目标，也不会误走 Execute Mode 的单目标 recognition plan。

Learn Mode 精准定位现在会对所有子路径控件做坐标校验：每个 `learn_all_targets.targets[]` 都写入 `coordinate_validation`，检查 bbox 是否有效、click point 是否存在、点是否在 bbox 内、bbox/点是否落在图片边界内；汇总写入 `validated_count`、`invalid_count` 和 `path_map_review.summary`。同时生成 `coordinate_overlay_path` / `learn_all_targets.overlay_path` 坐标框图，locate trace 会保留这些字段，面板截图预览会优先显示这张带框校验图。

Learn Mode 精准定位现在会在 `learn_depth="deep"` 时默认运行 `learn_locate_model_review_v1`：模型审查会基于最新 Observe trace 的 `screen_map_v1`、OCR 文本、UIA 和截图，提出 add/update/remove 决策，用来补充遗漏子节点、修正错误 bbox/click_point、重命名误标节点并删除重复/噪声节点。合并后的候选再统一写入 `learn_all_targets`、`path_map_review_v1` 和坐标框 overlay；模型失败时保留确定性坐标校验结果并把失败写入 trace。

### 2026-06-13 Learn Fast / Deep UI 语义调整

最新 Lonlife ACC Learn Deep trace `logs/traces/vision/20260615-173135-076613__locate-target__lonlife-acc.json` 总耗时 `88293.583ms`，其中 `learn_locate_model_review` 占 `87572.496ms`。该阶段错误地使用了当前默认 `local_grounding` 的 VISTA 点定位模型来做 full-map add/update/remove 审查，模型只返回 `vista_point_v1` 点 `[138,32]`，没有产生有效路径图审查结果。

### 2026-06-15 普通软件 PathGraph 分区修复

Lonlife ACC 路径图截图暴露出旧分区规则过度套用浏览器页面假设：只要窗口宽度 `>=900` 就生成 `right_sidebar`，并且总是生成 `browser_chrome/page_header`，导致普通软件里的右侧按钮被误归到侧边栏。现在 `_screen_map_sections` 会先判断是否像浏览器/网页；浏览器型页面保留 `browser_chrome/page_header/main_content/right_sidebar/lower_content`，普通软件改用 `top_bar/primary_area/bottom_bar`。`right_sidebar` 只有浏览器型页面且右侧有足够推荐/相关内容文本证据时才创建。

用 `logs/traces/vision/20260615-172644-072950__observe-screen__lonlife-acc.json` 的原始观察结果重新生成 screen_map 验证：sections 为 `top_bar`、`primary_area`、`bottom_bar`；候选 `加速/游戏/充值/搜索游戏/我的` 在 `top_bar`，`YY已加速/启动游戏/停止加速/点击参与/每邀请一名好友，` 在 `primary_area`，`或微信扫码参与` 在 `bottom_bar`。不再出现 `right_sidebar` 或 `browser_chrome`，并过滤了顶栏单字符 OCR 噪声 `L/Q`。

### 2026-06-15 Execute Direct VISTA fallback

执行模式新增 Direct VISTA 找目标路径：当 `POST /vision/recognition_plan` 使用 `agent_mode=execute`、`local_grounding.output_contract=vista_point_v1`，且没有可用 `path_graph_recall_v1` 候选时，会调用 VISTA 直接对当前 goal 输出点坐标。返回点会被包装为 `vista_direct_*` 临时候选和小 bbox，再进入 `pre_click_decision_v1`；成功时 `execution_path.vista_direct_point_grounding_used=true`。这不是裸点点击，仍然必须通过 Gate，真实点击仍走 `POST /action/execute_recognition_plan`。

如果 Direct VISTA 超时或失败，`recognition_plan` 现在返回 blocked plan，并写入 `model_io.status=failed`、`execution_path.vista_direct_point_grounding_attempted=true` 和错误原因，不再让整个 API 直接失败。实际 smoke：在 VISTA 服务被旧超时线程拖住时，Google News `Click Home` direct 请求 10 秒超时，trace 为 `logs/traces/vision/20260615-184658-238938__recognition-plan__google-news.json`，结果为 `allowed=false`。清理并重启 VISTA 后，不带 `observe_trace_path` 的 Google News `Click Home` direct 请求在 `2138.163ms` 完成，trace 为 `logs/traces/vision/20260615-184828-403551__recognition-plan__google-news.json`，raw 为 `[39, 141]`，换算点 `{x:50,y:171}`，`pre_click_decision.allowed=true`。

### 2026-06-15 Execute Mode agent guidance

`POST /action/execute_recognition_plan` 现在更适合作为上层 agent 的单一执行入口：当请求为 `agent_mode="execute"` 且没有显式 `provider_mode` 时，内部 `recognition_plan` 默认使用 `local_grounding`，并注入受限的 `metadata.vista_direct_grounding={enabled:true, timeout_seconds:45.0, max_edge:640}` 与 `execute_mode_policy`。因此 agent 只需要给目标、应用上下文、可选 `observe_trace_path` 和 `dry_run`，不用知道当前后端是 VISTA 还是旧 grounding 模型。

执行响应新增 `agent_execution_guidance_v1`。dry-run 通过时返回 `next_action="execute_approved_plan"` 和可直接复用的 `POST /action/execute_recognition_plan` 请求体，其中包含 `approved_plan_id`、`dry_run=false` 和验证配置；真实点击并验证成功时返回 `next_action="done"`；识别失败、Gate 拒绝、点击异常或点击后验证失败时返回 `next_action="recover_with_fallback_plan"`，并把 `execute_fallback_plan_v1` 放进 guidance。这个字段只指导编排，不改变安全规则：真实点击仍必须通过 approved plan/recognition plan、`pre_click_decision_v1` 和 post-click verification。

### 2026-06-15 Execute Mode 单步 MVP 契约

Execute Mode 明确为单步原子动作，不在后端内部做多步路线编排。每次 `POST /action/execute_recognition_plan` 都会返回 `agent_step_result_v1`，用于上层 agent 判断下一次是否继续调用 Execute。该摘要包含：`status`、`selected_click_point`、`approved_plan_id`、输入截图、recognition trace、坐标 overlay、action trace、post-click before/after/diff 证据、失败原因、fallback plan 和 `next_agent_action`。dry-run、Gate 拒绝、识别失败、点击异常、验证失败和验证成功分支都会写入该字段，并同步进入 action trace。

新增外部 smoke 脚本 `scripts/smoke_execute_single_step.py`：默认先调用 `/state/capture_window` 获取框架截图，再调用 Execute dry-run 并输出 `agent_step_result_v1` 摘要；只有显式传 `--execute` 才会复用 approved plan 执行真实单步点击。2026-06-15 在当前 Edge/ChatGPT 窗口上运行 dry-run smoke：框架截图成功，返回 `status="blocked"`、`failure_reason="pre_click_rejected"`、action trace `logs/traces/actions/20260615-210518-712979__execute-mode-plan-preview__edge.json`、recognition trace `logs/traces/vision/20260615-210518-667981__execute-mode-recognition-plan__edge.json`、overlay `artifacts/review-overlays/20260615-210518-667981-execute-mode-recognition-plan-edge__recognition-plan-overlay__20260615-210518-669980.png`。目标控件未通过 Gate，因此没有真实点击，符合安全预期。

旧的 `tests/test_execute_recognition_plan_route.py` 主要覆盖 MouseTester/旧 grounding 假设，已替换为新的 Execute Mode agent 契约测试。当前测试覆盖：绑定窗口 app alias 不匹配时在截图前拒绝、dry-run 生成坐标预览、`agent_step_result_v1`、`approved_plan_id`、下一次调用复用 approved plan 并跳过 recognition、真实点击后 before/after/diff 证据、Gate 拒绝时返回 `execute_fallback_plan_v1` / `agent_execution_guidance_v1` / `agent_step_result_v1`、`write_policy.trace=false` 不写 action trace、真实 saved-image 执行默认被阻止。

### 2026-06-15 绑定窗口失效防线

`WindowManager.get_bound_window()` 现在每次读取绑定窗口都会校验保存的 handle 是否仍然是可见的顶层有标题窗口，并尝试刷新窗口快照。如果 handle 已失效、窗口变成隐藏/子窗口/无标题，或 `HwndWrapper` 刷新失败，运行时会清空绑定并返回 `None`。这样 `/state/capture_window` 和 Execute Mode 不会继续拿过期窗口矩形截图，也不会在实际绑定已经漂移时生成错误 trace 或点击计划。

### 2026-06-15 ChatGPT 汇报/咨询工作流

`AGENTS.md` 已加入 ChatGPT reporting / consultation 规则：遇到较大、架构性、高风险、模糊、卡住或用户明确要求外部复核的任务时，如果本机已安装 `codex-chatgpt-control` 且可见 ChatGPT 浏览器 bridge 可用，agent 应把当前目标、计划、关键证据、blocker 和下一步汇报给 ChatGPT 或请求复核。该规则只作为可见、用户导向的咨询层，不替代本地实现循环、测试、trace 证据、GUI 安全 Gate 或用户最终确认。若出现未登录、验证码、selector drift、权限、rate limit 或缺少 browser bridge，需要报告结构化 blocker，不能假装已经咨询成功。

执行模式测试本地 `Execute MVP Test` 页面时，`click Start` dry-run 不是因为 Gate 单纯过严失败，而是 `candidate_result.candidates=[]`。继续追 trace 后确认 Direct VISTA 已尝试，但 `model_io.status=failed` 且错误为 `timed out`。用同一张保存截图直接请求 `http://127.0.0.1:1244/v1/chat/completions` 也在 45 秒后超时，说明根因在 VISTA 服务生成层，而不是 Execute/Gate。

进一步检查发现 VISTA 相关 Python 进程存在重复/陈旧状态：`netstat` 显示 1244 监听进程为 `50976`，但 `logs/vista-4b-transformers-server.pid` 写的是旧 PID `47776`，同时还存在另一个 VISTA Python 进程。为避免“失败也显示正常”，`scripts/model_servers/vista_openai_server.py` 已加入单飞生成锁：同一时间只允许一个 VISTA generate；忙时返回 `503 model_busy`，`/health` 会返回 `status="busy"`、`pid` 和 `active_request`。`app/core/model_server.py` 的 `check_model_server()` 现在会对 Transformers/VISTA profile 读取 `/health`，如果 busy 就返回 `status="busy"`；`ensure_model_server()` 遇到 busy 不会再启动第二个实例。

同时 `AGENTS.md` 已加入 Root Cause Before Fallback 规则：失败时先用 trace/log/screenshot 定位并修主路径，不能先用 fallback 掩盖模型协议错误、服务卡死、重复进程、窗口漂移、候选生成或坐标变换 bug。当前没有重启 VISTA live 服务，因为用户正在玩游戏，避免加载模型影响前台；live 验证需要等用户允许后清理旧进程并重启 VISTA。

用户随后允许后台重启 VISTA，但要求不要切前台。已只清理后台 `vista_openai_server.py` 进程和 1244 端口，未操作浏览器/前台窗口/真实点击。重启新 VISTA 进程时模型加载失败，stderr 报 `OSError: os error 1455`，即 Windows 页面文件/虚拟内存不足；新代码已把该错误转成明确提示：“VISTA model load failed because Windows reported insufficient virtual memory”。已清理 stale pid，当前 1244 没有 VISTA 监听进程，`/runtime/models` 显示 `vista_4b_transformers` 为 `unreachable`。下一次 live 验证需要在释放内存/增加页面文件后重新启动 VISTA。

### 2026-06-16 VISTA 缩放准确率 benchmark 与 Sprint 2 ROI refine

已再次通过 ChatGPT 会话复核缩放准确率策略。建议采用可标注样本集评估，而不是只看模型是否返回点：每个 case 记录保存截图、goal、expected bbox、expected click point、allowed distance 和相邻候选；每档 max_edge 输出 latency、processed size、mapped original point、是否落入 expected bbox、到 expected click 的距离、edge margin、是否命中相邻 bbox、Gate 是否允许。PASS 建议为点在 expected bbox 内、距离不超过 allowed distance、edge margin 至少 6px；贴边/近邻为 risky；出框或命中相邻 bbox 为 fail。

### 2026-06-16 PathGraph candidate ROI refine 主路径

已再次向 ChatGPT 复核下一步优先级，建议排序为 `B PathGraph candidate ROI refine > C 扩 benchmark > A 自适应 max_edge > D`。理由是 no-PathGraph direct fallback 已经可用，但 Execute 的真正主路径应该是 `PathGraph recall -> candidate ROI -> VISTA refine -> original-coordinate Gate`；继续优化 direct fallback 的 max_edge 不如先把主路径修快修稳。

已实现 PathGraph + VISTA 主路径 ROI refine：当 `path_graph_recall_v1` 返回候选时，不再把整张原图发给 VISTA。adapter 会按候选分数选择 ROI：top1 分数明显领先时裁 top1，否则合并 top candidates；默认 padding `48px`、最小 ROI `256px`、最长边 `640`。候选 bbox 会转换为 processed ROI image 坐标写入 prompt，避免“局部图 + 原图坐标”的混淆。VISTA 返回点映射回原图后，仍按原图坐标检查是否落入召回候选 bbox，再进入 `pre_click_decision_v1`。trace/model_io 会记录 `locate_strategy=pathgraph_candidate_roi_refine`、候选摘要、ROI bounds、processed image、transform、raw output、processed point 和 mapped original point。

验证：`python -m py_compile app\api\vision.py app\api\action.py scripts\benchmark_vista_scaling.py` 通过；`uv run pytest tests\test_vision_route.py -q -k "path_graph_candidate_roi or vista_point_grounding or vista_direct"` 通过 `5 passed, 12 deselected`；`uv run pytest tests\test_execute_recognition_plan_route.py -q` 通过 `6 passed`；`uv run pytest tests\test_vision_route.py -q` 通过 `17 passed`；`uv run pytest tests\test_vista_scaling_benchmark.py -q` 通过 `3 passed`。重启 runtime 后，用 synthetic Observe trace + 保存截图调用 `/vision/recognition_plan`（非点击）验证真实 VISTA：`strategy=pathgraph_candidate_roi_refine`，`roi_source=top1_only`，ROI `{x:312,y:592,w:256,h:256}`，processed size `256x256`，最终点 `{x:408,y:713}`，`model_io.attempt_count=1`，`execution_path.path_graph_candidate_roi_refine_used=true`，`pre_click_decision.allowed=true`，总耗时约 `973.1ms`，trace 为 `logs/traces/vision/20260616-015431-061860__execute-mode-recognition-plan__edge.json`。

### 2026-06-16 ChatGPT bridge recovery and Learn Fast optimization review

用户要求以后 ChatGPT 窗口仍打开但 bridge 不可用时，不要直接报告失败，而是先重启/恢复 bridge。`AGENTS.md` 已更新 ChatGPT Reporting / Consultation Rule：当 `globalThis.agent` / browser bridge 缺失时，先在 `node_repl` 中加载 Chrome plugin runtime，执行 `setupBrowserRuntime({ globals: globalThis })`，再设置 `globalThis.browser = await agent.browsers.get("extension")`，重新跑 bridge/doctor 检查并重试一次 consult；只有登录/captcha/selector drift/rate limit/权限/bridge bootstrap 失败才报告结构化 blocker。

已按新流程实测：初始 `globalThis.agent=false`，bootstrap 后 `hasAgent=true`、`hasBrowser=true`。随后 ChatGPT Control SDK 的 `messages.ask` 仍失败，根因不是 bridge，而是本地化 selector drift：SDK 等待的 textbox name 列表未覆盖当前简体中文输入框 aria label `与 ChatGPT 聊天`。通过 Chrome bridge 直接 claim 用户打开的 ChatGPT tab，DOM 检查确认可见输入框为 `div[contenteditable="true"][aria-label="与 ChatGPT 聊天"]`，发送按钮为 `button[data-testid="send-button"]` / aria `发送提示`。使用低层 Chrome 控制填入咨询问题并坐标点击发送按钮成功。

GPT Pro 对“8B 可操作元素发现约 20 秒如何优化”的复核结论：不要继续把 8B 当整屏元素发现器优化；20 秒主要是职责放错，而不是单纯分辨率问题。推荐主线为 `Learn Fast = deterministic high-recall PathGraph draft`，`8B = ROI semantic reviewer / background deep reviewer`，`VISTA = Execute-time precise point grounding`，`Gate = final safety decision`。

GPT 建议的 MVP：

- Learn Fast 主路径不调用 8B whole-screen，改为并行 deterministic collectors：capture/state signature、OCR、UIA、浏览器 DOM、visual geometry/icon/card heuristics。
- fusion 输出 `operable_candidate_v1`，每个候选保留 source evidence ids、bbox、click_point_hint、role、label、confidence 分项。
- 输出 `path_graph_fast_v1`，先做基础 region/inside/near/same-row/card/nav/toolbar 边，不追求复杂全图推理。
- 8B 只用于 optional ROI semantic review：候选语义命名、textless icon 解释、complex card/region grouping、missing-suspect audit；不要让 8B 输出最终点击坐标或重写整个 PathGraph。
- 分辨率建议：Learn Fast 主路径不送 8B；optional 8B ROI review 用单 ROI `384/512 max_edge`，montage `1280 max_edge`，输出 `512-800 tokens`；后台 Learn Deep 才允许 `1280 max_edge` 和 `1500-2500 tokens`。
- benchmark 分四层：collector timings、element discovery golden recall/precision/duplicate/role/label/bbox/click-point、PathGraph recall@1/@3/@5、downstream Execute dry-run/click/post-click。
- 最小 benchmark cases：MouseTester/简单按钮、Notepad、受控 Start/Continue/Done 页面、复杂网页；MVP 目标为简单场景 golden recall `>=90%`，复杂网页 `>=80%`，PathGraph recall@3 核心目标 `>=80%`。

下一步建议实现 P0：扩大截图理解 benchmark 的页面数量和窗口尺寸覆盖，重点修 Pay/posted 等小筛选文字召回；4B 作为 Fast 默认路径，8B 只保留为 Learn Deep/background review 或人工对照基线。

### 2026-06-16 Execute scroll recovery action

本轮补齐 Execute Mode 的“信息不全先滚动再重试”主路径。新增 `ScrollRequest` 和 `POST /action/scroll`：当前绑定窗口存在时，默认在窗口中心发送上下滚轮，也可传入窗口相对 `x/y` 指定某个可滚动 pane；`dry_run=true` 只校验窗口和坐标，不发送输入；真实滚动会通过 `SendInput` 派发 `MOUSEEVENTF_WHEEL`，并在 `enable_verification=true` 时记录滚动前后状态和 `post_scroll_verification`。返回 contract 为 `scroll_action_v1`，action trace operation 为 `scroll`。

`execute_fallback_plan_v1` 也加入 `request_scroll` 步骤：当识别计划失败、候选为空、缺少候选或所有候选都没有通过 pre-click checks 时，fallback 会建议调用 `POST /action/scroll`，然后用同一个 goal 重新调用 `POST /action/execute_recognition_plan`。该步骤只是 reveal/navigation 恢复动作，不授予点击权限，也不会绕过下一次 `pre_click_decision_v1`。

验证：`$env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'; .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m py_compile app\models\request.py app\core\input_controller.py app\api\action.py` 通过；`$env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'; .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests\test_click_text_route.py tests\test_execute_recognition_plan_route.py -q` 通过 `14 passed`。当前已验证 API 单元路径和 fallback contract；下一步建议在 SEEK job detail 或任意长页面上重启 runtime 后做一次真实 `/action/scroll` smoke，检查前后截图差异和随后同 goal Execute 重试。

### 2026-06-17 SEEK MVP container-aware scroll slice

项目目标已调整为 SEEK 自动求职 MVP：不是自动提交申请，而是在真实 SEEK 页面完成可解释、可 gated、可测试的岗位遍历、详情读取、匹配判断、进入申请流程、填写到最终提交前停止，并输出 `seek_mvp_run_report_v1`。完整拆解写入 `SEEK_MVP_PLAN.md`。

本轮实现第一块底座：SEEK 三容器滚动。新增 `app/seek/scroll_containers.py`，以 deterministic heuristic 输出 `scroll_containers_v1`，包含 `seek:page`、`seek:results_list`、`seek:job_detail`，每个容器带 `pane_role`、`scroll_scope`、bbox、safe point、confidence 和 evidence。`ScrollRequest` 扩展为兼容旧窗口滚动和新 container-aware 滚动，支持 `scroll_scope`、`target_pane`、`target_container_id`、`container_bbox`、`coordinate_window_size`、`goal_id`、`task_chain_id`、`reason`、`missing_evidence`、`expected_effect` 和 `scroll_history`。

`POST /action/scroll` 在传入 container 请求时会解析目标容器，返回 `scroll_action_v2`，并在发送滚轮前生成 `scroll_precondition_decision_v1`：检查点是否在窗口内、坐标尺寸是否匹配、目标容器是否存在、点是否在容器内、容器是否可向指定方向滚。真实滚动后会记录 `scroll_effect_validation_v1` 和 `outcome.should_retry_goal=true`，提示上层 agent 用同一个 goal 重新调用 `POST /action/execute_recognition_plan`。旧的 window-level scroll 仍保持 `scroll_action_v1`。

`execute_fallback_plan_v1` 的 `request_scroll` 对 SEEK 上下文变为语义容器请求：详情类目标如 Requirements / responsibilities / Apply 会建议 `seek:job_detail`，职位列表/卡片类目标会建议 `seek:results_list`。普通非 SEEK 页面仍保留旧的窗口级滚动建议，避免把 Edge 上的其他网站误判为 SEEK。

验证：`$env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'; .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m py_compile app\models\request.py app\seek\scroll_containers.py app\api\action.py` 通过；`$env:PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8'; .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests\test_click_text_route.py tests\test_execute_recognition_plan_route.py -q` 通过 `17 passed`。新增测试覆盖 `seek:job_detail` container dry-run、坐标窗口尺寸不匹配拒绝、SEEK Requirements 目标 fallback 指向右侧详情 pane。尚未实现 DOM/UIA ScrollPattern/视觉滚动条融合、岗位卡片/详情抽取、匹配打分、申请流程和最终报告。

### 2026-06-17 SEEK MVP no-apply traversal runner skeleton

新增 `scripts/seek_mvp_traversal_runner.py`，把已有 API 串成 SEEK no-apply traversal 骨架：

7. 输出 no-final-submit 的 `seek_mvp_run_report_v1` JSON。

### 2026-06-17 SEEK Apply Entry final-submit guard slice

本轮补齐 Apply Entry 的执行层安全守门。`POST /action/execute_recognition_plan` 新增 `final_submit_guard_v1`：当请求 metadata 带 `forbid_final_submit=true` 时，会从 pre-click 选中候选、recommended target、candidate result 和 grounding 文本中检查 `submit application`、`send application`、`complete application`、`submit` 等最终提交词；一旦命中，会在调用 `input_controller.click_point` 前返回 `final_submit_guard_rejected`，并把 guard 证据写入 action trace / `agent_step_result`。`agent_execution_guidance.next_request` 现在也保留 request metadata，避免 agent 复用 approved plan 时丢失 `forbid_final_submit`。

`scripts/seek_mvp_traversal_runner.py` 的 `--apply-entry` 阶段现在记录 `apply_click.container_id=seek:job_detail`、`submit_clicks=0`、`form_fields_filled=0`、`final_submit_guard` 和 `final_submit_guard_active`。Apply Entry 请求会带 `forbid_final_submit=true` 和 `required_container_id=seek:job_detail`，仍只默认允许 `strong_apply`，`maybe_apply` 需要显式 `--allow-maybe-apply`。点击 Apply / Quick Apply 后只 observe 一次、输出 `seek_application_flow_state_v1`，然后以 `blocked_need_user_or_gpt_decision` 停下；runner 会立即停止整轮 traversal，不继续打开后续岗位。本阶段不填表、不点 Continue/Next、不点最终 Submit。

验证：`python -m py_compile app\api\action.py scripts\seek_mvp_traversal_runner.py app\seek\application.py` 通过；`uv run pytest tests\test_execute_recognition_plan_route.py tests\test_seek_mvp_traversal_runner.py tests\test_seek_application.py -q` 通过 `21 passed`；扩大相关集合 `uv run pytest tests\test_seek_application.py tests\test_seek_matching.py tests\test_seek_mvp_traversal_runner.py tests\test_seek_extraction.py tests\test_seek_traversal.py tests\test_click_text_route.py tests\test_execute_recognition_plan_route.py -q` 通过 `49 passed`。新增测试覆盖：危险 `Submit application` 候选在 action 层点击前被阻断且 click controller 未调用；Apply Entry mock run 在 `--max-jobs 2` 下仍于首个 Apply Entry 状态后停止，报告 `application_flows_started=1`、`submit_clicks=0`、`form_fields_filled=0`、`forms_filled_until_review=0`、`final_submissions=0`、`apply_click.container_id=seek:job_detail` 和启用的 `final_submit_guard_v1`。真实安全回归：`uv run python scripts\seek_mvp_traversal_runner.py --max-jobs 1 --max-detail-scrolls 6 --max-results-scrolls 4 --execute-clicks --candidate-profile tests\smoke\seek_candidate_profile_smoke.json --saved-jobs-dir artifacts\seek\saved-jobs-smoke --out logs\smoke\seek_mvp_traversal_real_1_no_apply_after_guard_stopfix.json` 成功，`mode=no_apply_traversal`、`jobs_seen=1`、`jobs_opened=1`、`jobs_fully_read=1`、`maybe_apply=1`、`application_flows_started=0`、`submit_clicks=0`、`form_fields_filled=0`、`final_submissions=0`、耗时约 `79704.697ms`。该小节之后的 live smoke 已完成，见下一节。

### 2026-06-17 SEEK Apply Entry live smoke and guard root-cause fixes

本轮把真实 SEEK Apply / Quick Apply entry smoke 跑通，并修复两个主路径问题，而不是用 fallback 掩盖：

- `extract_seek_job_detail()` 之前只从 `available_actions` 找 Apply；真实 trace 中 action label 为 `Apply button`，但 bbox 落在 `seek:job_detail` 外，导致 `apply_button_state.visible=false`。现在当 action bbox 不可信时，会从右侧详情 pane 内的 page text 中识别 `Apply` / `Quick Apply` 文本按钮，例如真实 OCR 文本 `Apply C`，并生成容器内 click point。
- `final_submit_guard_v1` 之前会把目标指令里的负约束 `Do not click Submit...` 当成候选文本，误判 Apply 为最终提交风险。现在 guard 只检查目标 evidence，过滤 goal/instruction-like 文本，仍会阻断真实 `Submit application` / `Send application` / `Complete application` 候选。

### 2026-06-18 panel drag threshold fix

用户继续指出拖动手感问题：不应该点击卡片顶部就立即跟随鼠标，应该按住并拖动后才进入拖动状态，松手再落位。本轮修正拖动启动条件：

- 新增 `pendingCardDrag` 状态。

### 2026-06-18 operational model profile dropdown cleanup

用户发现 Observe 页模型下拉出现 `MiniCPM-V 4.6 Transformers`，本轮确认原因并修正：

- 该 profile 当前是 benchmark-only：
  - `runtime=transformers_direct`
  - `launchable=false`

  - Observe/Locate 操作下拉没有过滤 `launchable=false`。
  - 下拉填充后浏览器自动选中第一个 option，旧逻辑把这个自动选中误当成有效选择保存，导致排在前面的 MiniCPM 可能被默认选中。
- 已修复：
  - Observe/Locate 等操作链路下拉只显示 `launchable !== false` 的 profile。
  - `fillModelSelect()` 不再把浏览器自动选中的第一个 option 当作默认值，而是显式使用 `DEFAULT_STAGE_PROFILE_IDS`。
  - Model Test 页面仍保留 MiniCPM profile，方便以后 benchmark/调试，但它不会进入操作链路默认选择。

- `uv run pytest tests\test_web_panel_route.py -q` 通过 `18 passed`。

### 2026-06-18 panel card drag primary-path fix

用户反馈卡片拖动仍有明显 bug：按住拖动后其他卡片闪烁，且拖动系统会影响上方运行管线/标题区域。本轮按 root-cause 修主路径：

- 根因：
  - 旧实现每次 `mousemove` 都直接 `insertBefore(card, ...)` 移动真实卡片，导致 DOM 持续重排，所以其他卡片闪烁。
  - `sortableContainers()` 把 `.workspace` 也加入拖拽容器，导致 `flow-diagram-strip`、`topbar`、`policy-strip` 等顶部区域也被纳入拖动系统。
- 修复：
  - 拖动容器只保留 `.control-surface` 和 `.response-surface`，顶部运行管线/标题/写入策略不再参与拖动。
  - 拖动时真实卡片变成 fixed floating card，跟随鼠标移动。
  - 原位置使用 `.card-drag-placeholder` 占位；只有 placeholder 到达新位置时布局才调整。
  - `mousemove` 用 `requestAnimationFrame` 合并更新，减少高频重排。
  - 松手后再把真实卡片落到 placeholder 位置并保存布局。

验证：

- `node --check app\web_panel\panel.js` 通过。
- `uv run pytest tests\test_web_panel_route.py -q` 通过 `18 passed`。
- in-app browser 验证：
  - `flow-diagram-strip` / `topbar` 没有 `card-drag-zone`。
  - 使用卡片顶部拖动区可以把 `打开 / 绑定` 从左侧控制区拖到右侧响应区。
  - 松手后没有残留 `.card-drag-placeholder` 或 `.dragging`。
  - 点击“重置布局”后卡片回到默认控制区布局。

### 2026-06-20 runtime cleanup and trace budget guard

本轮处理项目目录膨胀问题，先修主路径再清理旧产物：

- 根因：`/action/scroll` 等 action trace 会把 request/result 写入 `write_trace`；旧 debug 循环中的 `scroll_history` / 大响应可能递归膨胀，导致单个 scroll trace 达到数百 MB 到 1GB。
- 修复：`app\core\runtime_artifacts.py::write_trace` 新增 bounded trace 保护。
  - 正常小 trace 保持原 JSON 结构。
  - 超长字符串会记录 hash/preview/长度。
  - `scroll_history` / history 类列表会截断。
  - `image_base64` / bytes / binary-like 字段只写摘要。
  - 整体超过 `OPENCLAW_TRACE_MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES` 时写 `bounded_trace_summary_v1`，并标记 `trace_truncated=true`。
- 清理：
  - 移出旧巨型 action trace、旧 smoke 大报告和可再生视觉 artifact 到 `D:\agent-gui-runtime_cleanup_quarantine_20260620`。
  - 删除可再生 `.uv-cache`。
  - 保留 `models`、`.venv`、`tools`、源码、测试、SEEK milestone JSON、templates、skills。
  - 清理 manifest：`logs\cleanup\cleanup_manifest_20260620_v2.json`、`logs\cleanup\cleanup_manifest_20260620_v3.json`。
- 体积结果：
  - 项目目录从约 `29.7GB` 降到约 `25.6GB`。
  - `logs\traces\actions` 最大文件从约 `1.08GB` 降到约 `6.3MB`。
  - `artifacts` 从约 `569MB` 降到约 `26MB`。

### 2026-06-20 low-risk navigation gate relaxation

根据真实 agent 测试反馈，搜索框输入不稳定时需要允许首页推荐卡片这类只读导航入口参与测试，而不是把所有 `safe_dry_run_only` 都一刀切阻断。

本轮调整：

- `app\api\vision.py` 新增低风险导航策略：
  - `card` / `news_card` / `job_card` / `result` / `link` / `title` / `row` / `article` / `detail` 等打开详情或阅读类目标，在不含危险动作词时，可从 `safe_dry_run_only` 放宽为可执行候选。

### 2026-06-20 agent trace digest for long traces

本轮根据外部 agent/GPT 读取长 trace 失败的反馈，新增了面向上层 agent 的 trace 摘要工具：

### 2026-06-20 app-open maximize default and DeepSeek run timing review

本轮检查 DeepSeek 外部 agent 的 SEEK 5 岗读取日志后确认两个问题：

- 截图信息少：`POST /apps/open` 之前只负责启动、等待、绑定，没有默认最大化或窗口标准化。现在 `OpenAppRequest.maximize_after_open` 默认 `true`，`/apps/open` 在绑定成功后会调用 `window_manager.maximize_bound_window()` 并把 `maximize_after_open` / `maximize_error` 写入 open-app 结果和 trace。手动绑定现有窗口不强制最大化，避免打断用户桌面；agent 新开测试窗口时应保持默认最大化。
- 速度慢：最新 trace 显示真正点击执行约 `1.9s`、滚动约 `1.7s`，瓶颈主要是重复 `Observe/screen_reading`（约 `15s..19s`）和部分 `vista_point_grounding_pathgraph_roi`（约 `21s..28s`）。后续优化应优先减少整屏 Observe 次数、复用已知 `seek:job_detail` / `seek:results_list` 容器、对重复卡片布局使用 `seeded_candidate_v1` 或已提取 bbox/click point，而不是每个岗位都重新跑大范围 VISTA grounding。

验证：

- `python -m py_compile app\api\apps.py app\models\request.py app\core\window_manager.py` 通过。
- `uv run pytest tests\test_apps_route.py -q` 通过 `7 passed`。

### 2026-06-20 VISTA compressed ROI primary path

根据 VISTA ROI grounding 偶发 `21s..28s` 的 trace 证据，本轮把执行模式的 VISTA 主路径收敛为“seed / 小 ROI 优先，整屏只做 fallback”：

- `metadata.seeded_candidate_v1` / `metadata.seeded_candidate` 存在时，`_recognition_plan_from_vista_point()` 只裁这个 seed 的单候选 ROI。
- seed ROI 参数改为 `padding=16`、`min_size=192`、`max_edge=448`，并在 `image_preprocess` 写入：
  - `roi_policy=compact_seed_candidate_roi_primary`
  - `roi_source=seeded_candidate_v1`
  - `fallback_tier=primary`
- 明确 top1 PathGraph 候选使用较小 ROI：`padding=32`、`min_size=224`、`max_edge=512`，策略为 `compact_pathgraph_top1_roi_primary`。
- 多候选 union ROI 保留，但标记为 `pathgraph_union_roi_fallback` / `fallback_tier=fallback`。
- 没有候选时的 VISTA direct 全屏路径标记为 `vista_direct_full_screen_fallback` / `fallback_tier=fallback`。
- `candidate_result.summary`、`narrow_search_result.summary`、`execution_path` 和 `agent_trace_digest_v1.vista_grounding` 都会输出 ROI policy/source/fallback tier、processed size 和 crop bounds，方便检查是不是走了压缩主路径。

验证：

- `python -m py_compile app\api\vision.py scripts\agent_trace_digest.py` 通过。
- `uv run pytest tests\test_vision_route.py -q -k "vista or seeded_candidate"` 通过 `14 passed, 17 deselected`。
- `uv run pytest tests\test_agent_trace_digest.py -q` 通过 `2 passed`。

### 2026-06-25 low-risk visual asset fast-lane live click

本轮把执行模式里的低风险视觉资产快车道接入 common action runtime，而不是写 SEEK 专属逻辑：

- `execute_recognition_plan` 会计算 `low_risk_visual_fast_lane_profile_v1`，只有在当前识别计划已经走 `visual_asset_fast_lane_used=true`、pre-click 允许、存在当前截图点击点、且目标文本不包含 final submit/send/confirm/payment 语义时才生效。
- dry-run 仍保留 `recognition_plan_overlay`，方便人工检查预渲染图。
- real click 且满足低风险快车道时跳过 overlay 渲染，并把 `effective_execution_options.click_timing` 写入 trace。
- 低风险快车道点击节奏为 `settle_ms=20`、`hold_ms=20`；默认 guarded click 仍保持 `settle_ms=200`、`hold_ms=70`。
- final submit guard 没有放宽；submit/send/confirm/payment 类目标不会进入这个低风险点击节奏。

真实 SEEK 外部 Edge 测试：

- Observe trace：`D:\agent-gui-runtime\logs\traces\vision\20260624-234240-146649__learn-mode-fast-observe__seek.json`
- Action trace：`D:\agent-gui-runtime\logs\traces\actions\20260625-000813-564299__execute-mode-click__seek.json`
- Recognition trace：`D:\agent-gui-runtime\logs\traces\vision\20260625-000813-421299__execute-mode-recognition-plan__seek.json`
- 目标：`click Job search`
- 结果：`clicked=true`，`visual_asset_fast_lane_used=true`，`vista_point_grounding_used=false`，`recognition_plan_overlay_rendered=false`
- runtime 总耗时 `980.725ms`，客户端 HTTP 往返实测 `1131.2ms`
- 主要耗时：`capture_live_window=720.460ms`，`recognition_plan=190.464ms`，`click_point=67.380ms`

剩余瓶颈：

- 低风险固定按钮已能在 runtime 内部进入 1 秒内；用户侧完整 HTTP 调用仍会受实时截图和请求往返影响。
- 下一步若要稳定压到客户端 1 秒内，需要优化截图路径，例如复用短 TTL 的新鲜截图、减少全窗口截图成本，或为低风险固定区域增加更小 ROI 的 live capture。


### 2026-06-25 visual asset review policy

本轮把“高危按钮截图要打特殊标签、审核后才能点击”的要求写入学习产物：

- `visual_asset_v1.review_policy` 新增三档：
  - `low_risk_fast_lane_eligible`：普通固定导航 / 搜索 / 打开类按钮，可走低风险视觉快车道。
  - `gate_required`：`Quick apply` / `Apply` / `Continue` / `Next` 这类流程入口，不等于最终提交，但仍必须走 scope / OCR / Gate，不进入低风险绿色通道。
  - `manual_review_required`：`Submit application` / `Send` / `Confirm` / `Payment` / `Complete application`，必须结构化审核，截图资产不能授权点击。
- `learned_interface_map.fixed_visual_assets[*]` 透传 `review_policy`、`click_permission`、`fast_lane_eligible`。
- `learned_interface_map.danger_zones[*]` 透传同一份 `review_policy`，方便面板单独显示高危按钮。
- `recognition_plan` 的视觉资产召回会读取 `asset_summary.review_policy`：新版学习产物如果标记 `fast_lane_eligible=false`，即使截图匹配成功，也不会进入低风险 fast lane。

### 2026-06-25 SEEK page-level node alignment

本轮继续修正 SEEK 学习产物的页面节点建模：

  - `seek_search_results_with_selected_job -> seek_home_page`
  - `seek_apply_entry_form -> seek_application_page`
- 前端新增 SEEK 兼容折叠：即使当前加载的是旧 live graph、没有 `display_states` 字段，也会自动把 `seek_*` 微状态折叠成 `seek_home_page` / `seek_application_page` 两个页面节点，并用同一映射查找页面详情里的 region。
- 页面节点对象现在会保留 `region_refs` / `required_regions` / `child_state_ids`。页面详情查不到 interface map state，或匹配到旧空 state 时，会使用当前路径节点自己的 region refs 渲染 `Screen regions`，避免出现“路径图已经两页，但页面详情区域为空”。
- 加载 interface map 后，如果页面上已有 runtime path graph，会自动用当前 graph 重绘一次，避免“先加载路径图、后加载区域图”导致旧节点对象没有 region refs。
- runtime path graph 节点点击不再二次收起旧 `expandedPathNodeId`。页面详情新增 `节点详情` 块，展示页面级节点折叠了哪些执行微状态、相关跳转和 region 数；region 卡片改为可展开详情，点击后能查看该区域里的固定按钮截图、动态 ROI 和高危区。
- 页面详情恢复右侧独立 `节点详情 / Inspector` 栏：点击页面节点默认显示该页面 state 字段；点击左侧 region、按钮截图、动态 ROI 或危险区，会在右侧显示字段、截图证据、JSON 和编辑入口，不再把 inspector 从主流程里移除。

### 2026-06-25 SEEK apply-state scoped form contract fix

真实 SEEK 小流程暴露的问题已收口为 runtime/app-adapter contract：

1. Failure：点击 Apply 入口后，runner 后续步骤报告 `risky_application_questions_blocked`，但 `employer_question_inventory.questions=[]`，实际截图/trace 仍在 SEEK 搜索结果/岗位详情页。
2. Root invariant violated：申请表单风险检测没有限定在 active application flow scope；搜索页里的 `Apply`、`salary range`、`application volume` 和 URL 输入框被混进 application form inventory。
3. Fix location：`app/seek/application.py` 的 SEEK application-state classifier。`risky_application_questions`、`screening_questions_detected`、`cover_letter_field_detected` 和 `application_form_detected` 现在必须先满足明确 apply flow 证据：apply route、当前申请步骤，或非泛化的申请流程关键词。泛化词 `application` 不再单独启动申请流。
4. Why not SEEK-only：这是 scoped form/danger detection 的应用层实现。其他 app adapter 也应遵守同一原则：只有 active form/modal/current flow container 成立后，才能用该容器里的字段触发高危/需用户决策。
5. Regression：新增 `test_application_flow_state_does_not_treat_search_results_as_risky_application`，覆盖真实失败特征：搜索页 URL、Apply 按钮、salary filter、application volume 同屏出现时不能触发 risky application。
6. Safety impact：没有放宽 final submit guard；修复只减少搜索/详情页误拦截。真正申请页里带 apply route 的 salary/work-rights 问题仍由 `test_application_flow_state_detects_risky_questions` 证明会被拦。

验证：

- `python -m py_compile app\seek\application.py` 通过。
- `uv run pytest tests\test_seek_application.py -q` 通过 `22 passed`。
- `uv run pytest tests\test_seek_speed_demo_runner.py -q` 通过 `5 passed`。
- `uv run pytest tests\test_runtime_contracts.py -q` 通过 `11 passed`。

### 2026-06-25 SEEK synthetic card extraction contract fix

真实 SEEK 3-job smoke 暴露了另一类可复用失败：

1. Failure：第一个岗位 Apply 后未进入申请页，runner 继续抽取下一个卡片时，`extract_cards` 生成了假岗位 `skills! Join our team as a Software Engineer and make a`，随后点击出现 `post_click_layout_drift`。
2. Root invariant violated：synthetic fallback 不能把岗位摘要/正文句子当成岗位标题；候选卡片必须有稳定的 card identity。
3. Fix location：`app/seek/extraction.py` 的 synthetic job card extraction。新增 `_looks_like_sentence_fragment_title`，只作用于 synthetic fallback，拒绝句首小写的长句片段、疑问句和明显正文动词片段。
4. Why not SEEK-only：这是通用“动态列表候选抽取”问题。任何列表型 GUI 都不能把正文摘要句当成可点击列表项标题，否则会把点击目标带偏。
5. Regression：新增 `test_extract_seek_job_cards_rejects_sentence_fragment_synthetic_title`，覆盖真实失败形态；同时保留 `Software Engineers (All levels!)` 这类合法标题，避免过度过滤。
6. Safety impact：没有放宽点击或提交策略；修复减少假候选进入 action layer 的概率。

- `python -m py_compile app\seek\extraction.py` 通过。

### 2026-06-25 SEEK runner contracts green again

在继续真实 SEEK 流程前，先收口 runner 已知 5 个失败。

第一类：safe form fill 的 post-fill verification。

1. Failure：字段已通过 `type_text` 填入后，post-fill observe 没有 Apply route / 进度条文本，被 `assess_seek_application_flow_state` 归为 `unknown_after_apply`，导致 `verified` / `unverified` / `final_submit_visible_after_fill` 三类结果都被错误变成 `stop_required`。
2. Root invariant violated：post-fill verification 已经处在安全字段填写上下文里，不能用普通 Apply 后页面分类把缺少 route 文本的页面直接当危险未知状态。
3. Fix location：`app/seek/application.py` 增加 `post_fill_context`；`scripts/seek_mvp_traversal_runner.py` 的 `_post_fill_verification()` 使用该上下文。
4. Why not SEEK-only：任何表单自动填写都需要“字段值验证”和“页面流程危险检测”分层；缺少 URL/进度条文本不应该让字段验证失效。
5. Regression：`test_safe_form_fill_attempt_uses_visible_bbox_before_model_focus`、`test_safe_form_fill_attempt_stops_when_post_fill_verification_unverified`、`test_safe_form_fill_attempt_stops_when_final_submit_visible_after_fill`。
6. Safety impact：没有放宽 final submit；post-fill context 反而让 `Submit application` 在填写后被正确识别为 `final_submit_visible_after_fill`。

第二类：Apply 入口前的旧滚动期望。

1. Failure：runner 测试仍要求 Apply 前强制滚回详情顶部 3 次；新实现如果当前观察已有 fresh Apply candidate，会跳过重置滚动。
2. Root invariant violated：测试仍绑定旧动作序列，没有表达新的 candidate freshness contract。
3. Fix location：`tests/test_seek_mvp_traversal_runner.py`，断言改为 fresh Apply seed 路径：`pre_apply_detail_reset.attempted == false`，dry-run metadata 带 `seeded_candidate.candidate_freshness`。
4. Why not SEEK-only：执行层应该优先使用当前截图候选，避免固定滚动动作拖慢或打乱滚动作用域；这对所有固定按钮视觉资产都适用。
5. Regression：`test_runner_apply_entry_for_strong_apply_starts_flow_and_stops`、`test_runner_apply_entry_blocks_when_current_detail_no_longer_matches`。
6. Safety impact：没有跳过 Gate；Apply dry-run / execute 仍走 `POST /action/execute_recognition_plan`，metadata 仍带 `forbid_final_submit` 和 `required_container_id=seek:job_detail`。

### 2026-06-25 SEEK no-submit smoke after Apply asset fix

在普通 `Apply` 与 `Quick Apply` 截图/语义拆分后，跑了一次小规模 SEEK no-submit smoke，目标是验证“筛选岗位 -> 打开详情 -> 完整阅读 -> 尝试申请入口，但不提交”。

命令：

```powershell
uv run python scripts\seek_speed_demo_runner.py --run-dir logs\smoke\seek_apply_nosubmit_verify_20260625_1 --url https://nz.seek.com/graduate-jobs/in-All-Auckland --max-jobs 3 --visible-jobs-per-page 3 --allow-maybe-apply --max-application-steps 2 --max-safe-fields-to-fill 0 --time-budget-ms 420000 --close-old-windows --window-width 2560 --window-height 1400 --timeout 90
```

结果：

- `success=true`，但 `status=needs_work`，`stop_reason=no_eligible_station_internal_apply_entry`。
- 总耗时 `230847.997 ms`，在 `420000 ms` 时间预算内。
- `final_submissions=0`，`submit_clicks=0`，没有执行最终提交。
- 第 1 个岗位 `Software Engineer Specialist-Integration / AIA New Zealand` 判断为 `strong_apply`，但入口是普通 `Apply`，按照规则识别为站外申请并跳过：`seek_standard_apply_is_external_use_quick_apply_only`。
- 第 2 个岗位 `Embedded Software Engineer / Garmin New Zealand Limited` 判断为 `strong_apply`，有 `Quick apply`，但申请前详情校验失败：观察到的详情标题/公司变为 `Employer site / SEEK`，因此被 `pre_apply_detail_verification_failed` 阻止。
- 滚动后再次打开卡片时出现 `post_click_layout_drift`：点击执行和视觉 diff 通过，但右侧详情标题缺失，未确认打开到目标岗位。

结论：

- 本次验证证明普通 `Apply` 不再被误当作 SEEK 站内申请入口，`Quick Apply` 才是站内申请入口。
- 本次验证同时提供了普通 `Apply` 的真实站外按钮截图，当前 crop 显示为 `Apply` 加外部打开图标，不再复用 `Quick apply` 图。
- 安全策略没有放宽，最终提交仍然保持强拦截。
- 下一步需要收口的不是截图资产，而是结果列表滚动后的卡片/详情稳定性：滚动后重新抽取的卡片需要更可靠地绑定到右侧详情标题，并在详情漂移时恢复到正确卡片。

## 2026-06-26 SEEK quick apply no-submit completion

本轮先停止继续“逐现象 patch”，把真实 SEEK 申请流程暴露的问题收口到 employer-question/dataflow 规则后，再跑真实流程。

修复：

- Employer question 规划层支持以下安全自动回答：
  - `work rights` / `right to work` / visa 类问题。
  - 期望薪资 / annual base salary / compensation range。
  - 英语水平、notice period、常见技能 checkbox。
- Work rights 不再把 profile 的长文本直接拿去匹配页面 radio；当 profile 是 post-study/open work visa，而页面可见选项是 `Current NZ Work Visa` 时，映射到可点击的可见选项。
- OCR 丢空格导致的重复问题会合并，例如 `What areyoursalary expectationsforthisposition?` 与 `What are your salary expectations for this position?` 只保留一个有输入框的题。
- 不可见/负坐标 checkbox 不会被执行层点击，会停在 review。
- final submit guard 未放宽；`Submit application` 仍只作为最终审核页证据和强拦截。

## 2026-06-29 SEEK岗位筛选改为agent完整JD审核

用户复核发现上一轮岗位筛选把不完整卡片摘要和关键词匹配误当成完整岗位证据，导致安全许可/长期背景审查岗位、硬件电气实习岗位、重复岗位被错误放行。新的用户要求是：本地 runtime 不再用关键词判断岗位是否合适，必须把读到的完整岗位内容交给 agent/GPT 判断。

修复：

- `app/seek/matching.py` 支持 profile 级 `job_search_preferences.screening_policy=agent_full_jd_review_required`。
- 该策略启用时，`score_seek_job()` 不再输出 `strong_apply`、`maybe_apply` 或 `skip` 作为本地适配结论，而是固定返回 `need_user_review`。
- 返回结果新增 `agent_review`，包含岗位卡片、详情身份和完整岗位文本 `full_job_text`，供 agent 基于完整 JD 判断。
- `scripts/seek_debug_step_runner.py` 和 `scripts/seek_mvp_traversal_runner.py` 已接入 `--agent-suitability-review`。
- review 文件支持 `agent_suitability_review_v1` 或 reviews list；只有对应岗位 verdict 为 `pass` / `suitable` / `open_apply_entry` / `apply_entry_allowed` 时，runner 才会把该岗位升级为 `strong_apply` 并允许 Apply Entry。
- verdict 为 reject/skip/not_suitable/do_not_apply 会转成 `skip`；缺少 verdict 或 needs-more-info 时继续停在 `need_user_review`。
- `D:\资料\CV\candidate_profile_wenqingji_20260629_enriched.json` 已启用该策略。
- 旧的关键词匹配逻辑仍可用于测试/非该策略 profile，但真实用户本次找岗流程不使用它做适配裁判。

验证：

- `uv run python -m py_compile app\seek\matching.py scripts\seek_mvp_traversal_runner.py scripts\seek_debug_step_runner.py` 通过。
- `uv run pytest tests\test_seek_matching.py -q`：`24 passed`。
- `uv run pytest tests\test_seek_debug_step_runner.py -q -k "match or apply_entry_requires or dry_run_apply_entry"`：`6 passed, 42 deselected`。
- `uv run pytest tests\test_seek_mvp_traversal_runner.py -q -k "apply_entry_blocks_need_user_review or runner_apply_entry_for_strong_apply or match_decision"`：`2 passed, 54 deselected`。
- 新增回归确认：即使岗位包含 Python/React/SQL/Auckland 等强关键词，只要 profile 启用 agent full JD review，本地也只会输出 `need_user_review` 和完整 agent 审核包，不会保存为 suitable job。
- 新增回归确认：debug runner 的 `match` step 会应用 agent pass verdict，并只在该情况下把下一步设为 `dry_run_apply_entry`。

后续真实 SEEK 首页推荐 run 必须先完整读取岗位详情，再把 `agent_review.full_job_text` 交给 agent 判断是否合适；只有 agent 明确通过的岗位才允许进入申请入口。仍然不填表、不提交。

## 2026-07-01 SEEK external ATS no-submit real test

本轮按“真实网站，不提交”重新验证 SEEK 学习产物和执行链路。流程先从 SEEK 岗位详情页打开普通 `Apply`，再进入外部 BambooHR 申请入口；全程没有点击 final submit，没有填写个人信息，没有上传文件。

真实测试暴露的共性问题：

1. Failure：BambooHR 页面可见 `申请此职位` 时，候选排序把 LinkedIn / Twitter / Facebook 分享按钮排到同一档，导致 `top_candidate_margin_too_small`。
2. Root invariant violated：当 goal 明确请求 Apply/申请 等动作时，候选排序必须区分“目标动作按钮”和“其他 action-like 按钮”，不能只靠普通文本相似度。
3. Fix location：`app/operation/recognition/candidate_ranker.py`。显式动作目标会产生 `explicit_action_target_match` / `explicit_action_target_mismatch` 排序原因；匹配动作按钮被提升，非匹配分享/上下文按钮被压低；泛化词 `application` 不再作为 Apply 动作词。
4. Why not app-only：任何外部 ATS、表单、文档网站都可能同时出现主动作按钮和分享/导航按钮，这属于通用 action-candidate ranking contract。
5. Regression：`tests/test_candidate_ranker.py::test_rank_candidates_promotes_explicit_apply_action_over_social_share_buttons`。
6. Safety impact：没有放宽 final-submit guard；`Apply` / `申请此职位` 仍只是 `open_apply_flow`，`Submit` / `Send` / `Confirm` / payment 仍强拦。真实 BambooHR 表单只做只读观察，未执行个人信息输入或文件上传。

真实证据：

- SEEK Apply dry-run：`logs\traces\actions\20260701-161850-627246__execute-mode-plan-preview__seek.json`。
- SEEK Apply click：`logs\traces\actions\20260701-161906-022707__execute-mode-click__seek.json`。
- 外部 BambooHR 到达观察：`logs\traces\vision\20260701-161935-483327__learn-mode-fast-observe__seek.json`。
- BambooHR `申请此职位` dry-run：`logs\traces\actions\20260701-162547-522754__execute-mode-plan-preview__edge.json`，选中 `candidate_screen_inventory_action_uia_26`，margin `0.2815`，原因包含 `explicit_action_target_match`。
- BambooHR `申请此职位` click：`logs\traces\actions\20260701-162607-390930__execute-mode-click__edge.json`。
- 进入申请表后的只读观察：`logs\traces\vision\20260701-162637-617419__learn-mode-fast-observe__edge.json`，首屏识别到名字、姓氏、电子邮件、电话、地址、城市、省、邮编、国家、Cover Letter 文件、Resume 文件、Date Available、Desired Pay 等字段，首屏未见 final submit。

## 2026-07-01 Learning Mode Observe-model primary path

用户指出学习模式不能直接把已有 SEEK 模板/PathGraph/Interface Map 资产整理成学习草稿；真正的学习模式应该调用 Observe 学习模型，让模型按参考模板格式输出 raw draft。已按这个定义重塑当前 SEEK learning draft 主路径。

变更：

- `GET /runtime/learning/seek/draft` 现在返回 `learning_generation_mode=observe_model`。
- `app.learn.pattern_draft.build_seek_learning_draft()` 先生成 `reference_baseline_summary`，再调用 Observe 模型任务 `learn_pattern_draft`。
- Observe 模型 prompt 要求返回 `learning_model_draft_v1`，其中包含 `pattern_candidates`、`learned_seek_template_draft`、`learned_navigation_path_graph_draft`、`learned_interface_details`、`learned_interface_map_draft` 和 safety。
- 已有 SEEK 资产只作为 prompt context / reference output shape / evaluation baseline；如果模型不可用或没有截图，输出保持 `model_output_missing`，`overall_learning_score.passed=false`，不会用 reference baseline 顶替学习结果。

## 2026-07-04 Learn Fast shared PathGraph isolation

用户反馈：进入 `整屏理解 / Learn Fast` 时，下面仍可能看到之前模板回放留下的共享 PathGraph 和页面详情。根因是前端公共 `navPathPanel` / `pathDetailPanel` 与模板回放、执行回放、学习页面共用同一套 DOM 状态；`observe_screen` 响应虽然最后会隐藏共享 surface，但中间仍可能走到 `ingestNavPathFromResponse()`，让旧模板/历史 PathGraph 状态短暂回流。

修复：

- `isScreenUnderstandingResponse()` 统一识别 `observe_screen`、`screen_observation_v1`、`screen_map_v1`。
- `responseAllowsPathGraphWrite()` 对整屏理解响应直接返回 false。
- `ingestNavPathFromResponse()` 对整屏理解响应直接跳过，避免先写共享 PathGraph 再隐藏。
- `enterScreenUnderstandingStage()` 强制按 `observe` 页面隐藏共享 PathGraph surface。
- `hideSharedPathSurface()`、`renderNavPath()` 的 hidden 分支和 `enterScreenUnderstandingStage()` 都会同步清空旧 canvas 和页面详情，避免模板回放残影继续显示。
- 追加前端 invariant：`isScreenUnderstandingStageActive()` / `shouldBlockPathGraphRestoreForScreenUnderstanding()` 在整屏理解页阻止 `restorePathGraph()` 恢复历史图，也阻止异步 `renderRuntimePathGraph()` 把模板/执行回放 PathGraph 重新画回共享区域。
- 追加学习草稿候选区清理：进入 `整屏理解 / Learn Fast`、重新截图或运行草稿试跑时，`clearLearningDraftTrialArtifacts()` 会清空旧 `trial_result`、学习草稿源路径、候选 PathGraph、候选校验报告、草稿 PathGraph 预览和页面详情，避免上一轮模板/草稿内容继续显示在当前整屏理解页下方。

安全边界：

- 只改面板展示/状态隔离；不改变 Execute Mode、Gate、Trace、final-submit guard、真实点击或 safe fill。
- 整屏理解仍只负责页面理解和学习草稿输入，不授权点击。

验证：

- `uv run pytest tests\test_web_panel_route.py -q`：`34 passed`。
- `node --check app\web_panel\panel.js` 通过。

为避免把“模型有输出”误读成“可以接 PathGraph”，`scripts/run_learn_recognition_actual_parser_batch.py` 现在输出两个下游连接指标：

最新 fresh actual parser batch 报告为 `logs\benchmarks\learn_recognition_actual_parser_batch_qwen8b_actionability_v1\learn_actual_parser_batch_report.json`。Qwen3-VL 8B learn-only profile 成功完成 5 个 actual parser call，`actual_parser_call=5/5`、`parse_inventory=5/5`，但 `parser_case_has_grounding_candidate=0/5`，`grounding_eligible_item_yield=0/60`；五个 case 都进入 `cases_without_grounding_candidates`。这说明当前 8B whole-screen parser 能给 review-only semantic inventory，但没有把 UIA/OCR/calibrated-target/OmniParser 等交互证据带进实际 parser 输出，因此还不能直接接 ROI grounding 或 PathGraph candidate。

- screenshot SHA: `356a9ce80f3b6039f8640db0fb292b37343f1b0b03218bb0fedb4d633b9b5515`
- `Search input`: bbox `{x:1454,y:90,w:222,h:36}`，click `{x:1565,y:108}`
- `GO search button`: bbox `{x:1686,y:88,w:48,h:40}`，click `{x:1710,y:108}`
- support artifact: `artifacts\benchmarks\learn_recognition_support_repair\python_homepage_saved_template_screenshot\same_screenshot_calibrated_support.json`

复跑诊断：

- report: `logs\benchmarks\learn_recognition_support_repair_python_saved_search_coordinate_diagnosis_v1\learn_pathgraph_readiness_blocker_diagnosis_report.json`
- `same_screenshot_support_status=matching_interactable_support_found`
- `interactable_support_count=1`
- `bbox_alignment_audit.status=support_found_but_bbox_alignment_failed`
- `bbox_alignment_audit.attempted=2`
- `bbox_alignment_audit.passed=0`
- `bbox_alignment_audit.coordinate_failure_categories={"raw_model_bbox_misaligned_before_remap":2}`
- best-match IoU 为 `0.0`，因为 Qwen actual parser 的 search 控件 bbox 偏移到 `{x:1119,y:134,w:193,h:39}` 附近，和同图人工校准目标无重叠。
- 坐标诊断会把 support bbox 投影回模型实际推理图坐标后再对比 raw model bbox。`Search input` raw model bbox 是 `{x:568,y:68,w:98,h:20}`，同图 reviewed support 投影后是 `{x:738,y:46,w:113,h:18}`；`GO search button` 也同样不重叠。因此当前失败归类为 raw model bbox / parser quality miss，不是 `coordinate_remap_or_scale_restore_failure`。
- zero-overlap best match 现在使用 label tie-breaker，`GO search button` 会匹配到 parser 的 `Search button`，不会因为所有 IoU 都为 0 而错误归到第一个 parser item。

结论：这个 case 的 blocker 已从 `no_same_screenshot_interactable_support` 细化为 parser bbox alignment failure。正确行为是继续阻断 PathGraph candidate / Execute binding，不允许把人工 support 反向覆盖成 parser 成功。下一步应修 actual parser 坐标输出、ROI/scale 还原或替换 parser/二阶段定位方案，再重新跑 alignment audit。

验证：

- `uv run pytest tests\test_learn_recognition_pathgraph_readiness_diagnosis.py -q`：6 passed。
- `uv run pytest tests\test_create_learn_recognition_calibrated_support.py tests\test_bind_learn_recognition_support_to_manifest.py -q`：4 passed。
- `uv run python -m py_compile scripts\create_learn_recognition_calibrated_support.py scripts\report_learn_recognition_pathgraph_readiness_diagnosis.py app\learn\recognition\bbox_alignment.py`：通过。
- `uv run python scripts\report_learn_recognition_pathgraph_readiness_diagnosis.py --status-report logs\benchmarks\learn_recognition_experiment_status_20260704_pathgraph_readiness\learn_recognition_experiment_status_report.json --parser-batch-report logs\benchmarks\learn_recognition_actual_parser_batch_qwen8b_grounding_backlog_20260704\learn_actual_parser_batch_report.json --manifest artifacts\benchmarks\learn_recognition_actual_parser_cases_v1.json --support-search-root artifacts\benchmarks\learn_recognition_support_repair --out logs\benchmarks\learn_recognition_support_repair_python_saved_search_coordinate_diagnosis_v1 --json`：通过。

边界：没有启动模型，没有 live click，没有 live safe fill，没有 submit，没有 Execute 授权，没有 PathGraph promotion，也没有宣传 90%。

## 2026-07-06 Learn Deep review-only overlay boxes

用户指出学习界面进入精确校准后，`filtered_non_actionable_count` 有内容但截图上没有对应框，导致看起来像没有真正划分区域。

修复：

- `app\api\vision.py` 新增 `learn_review_box_v1`：
  - 将 `filtered_non_actionable` candidate 转成 `review_boxes`；
  - 保留 label / role / bbox / click_point / section / source；
  - 固定 `execute_binding_enabled=false`、`artifact_is_authorization=false`。
- `learn_target_coordinate_overlay_v1` 现在同时输出：
  - `target_count`
  - `review_box_count`
  - `total_box_count`
- overlay 渲染现在会把可执行 target 继续画成原有 target 框，同时把不可操作候选和 OCR 文本细节画成橙色 `R*` review-only 框。即使 `target_count=0`，只要有 review-only 候选，也会生成带框截图。
- `app\web_panel\panel.js` 会把 `learn_all_targets.review_boxes` 传入 Learning Draft trial 的 `review_boxes` evidence。
- `app\api\panel.py` 会把这些 review boxes 作为 `sources.ocr.texts` 交给学习识别 parser，因此界面详情能看到标题、卡片文字、分区文字等只读 inventory，但不会生成 action template。
- 卡片识别的父子关系已明确化：
  - card review box 会保留 `children`；
  - card 内 OCR 文本不再重复成为同级编号框；
  - panel 会把 card/nav rail review boxes 作为 `sources.vision.regions`，纯 OCR 文本才进入 `sources.ocr.texts`；
  - parser 会把 card children 透传为 region metadata 的 `text_lines`。
- `_card_bbox_for_seed()` 改为围绕 seed 的连续文本簇，遇到大垂直间隔会停止，避免把下一组标题吞进当前卡片 bbox。该修复影响后续 fresh observe 生成的 screen_map；旧 trace 中已写死的旧 bbox 不会自动改写。
- 当 OCR/UIA 没有提供左侧符号栏时，Learn Deep 会从截图左侧窄栏扫描小图标区域，生成 `nav_rail_icon_review_only` 框。它们仍是 review-only，不授权点击。

真实 trace 复盘：

- 输入 observe trace：`logs\traces\vision\20260706-185730-078468__learn-mode-fast-observe__applemusic.json`
- 输入截图：`artifacts\screenshots\apple-music__observe-screen__applemusic__full-window__20260706-185715-285149.png`
- 输出 overlay：`artifacts\review-overlays\state-de1d0035bf730660-learn-targets__learn-target-coordinates__20260706-191218-519499.png`

- OCR 细节接入后复盘结果：`target_count=0`、`review_box_count=44`、`total_box_count=44`。

边界：

- 这些 review-only 框只用于学习草稿展示和人工审阅；
- 不进入可执行 target 分母；
- 不授权点击、输入、safe fill、submit 或 Runtime PathGraph promotion。

## 2026-07-06 Learning Mode demo scaffold checkpoint

在 page-detail candidate 之后，本轮补了一个更接近 demo 流程的串联层，把现有 review-only sidecar 一次性刷新出来，而不是让用户逐个点零散按钮。

- PathGraph detail 面板现在会渲染 `Learning demo scaffold` 流程卡，按顺序显示 full-screen/numbered-region evidence、precise-understanding candidate、PathGraph candidate review、integration readiness 和 template-like page detail 的状态与 artifact path。
